verses.textZh: 从前人烟稠密的城中，现在怎么竟然孤独地坐在那里。 从前在列国中为大的，现在怎么竟然像个寡妇。 从前在众省份中为王后的，现在怎么竟然成了奴隶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前人烟稠密的城中，现在怎么竟然孤独地坐在那里。 从前在列国中为大的，现在怎么竟然像个寡妇。 从前在众省份中为王后的，现在怎么竟然成了奴隶。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前满有人民的城， 现在何竟独坐！ 先前在列国中为大的， 现在竟如寡妇； 先前在诸省中为王后的， 现在成为进贡的。
verses.textEnNiv: How deserted lies the city, once so full of people! How like a widow is she, who once was great among the nations! She who was queen among the provinces has now become a slave.
verses.textEnEsv: How lonely sits the city that was full of people! How like a widow has she become, she who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave.
verses.textEnNkjv: How lonely sits the city Thatwas full of people! How like a widow is she, Who was great among the nations! The princess among the provinces Has become a slave!
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem, once so full of people, is now deserted. She who was once great among the nations now sits alone like a widow. Once the queen of all the earth, she is now a slave.
verses.textEnNasb: How lonely sits the city That once had many people! She has become like a widow Who was once great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces Has become a forced laborer!
verses.textEn: How deserted lies the city, once so full of people! How like a widow is she, who once was great among the nations! She who was queen among the provinces has now become a slave.

verses.textZh: 她在夜间痛哭，泪流满面。 在她所有亲爱的人中，没有一个安慰她的。 她所有的朋友都以诡诈待她，都成了她的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她在夜间痛哭，泪流满面。 在她所有亲爱的人中，没有一个安慰她的。 她所有的朋友都以诡诈待她，都成了她的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 她夜间痛哭，泪流满腮； 在一切所亲爱的中间没有一个安慰她的。 她的朋友都以诡诈待她， 成为她的仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: Bitterly she weeps at night, tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: She weeps bitterly in the night, with tears on her cheeks; among all her lovers she has none to comfort her; all her friends have dealt treacherously with her; they have become her enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: She weeps bitterly in the night, Her tears are on her cheeks; Among all her lovers She has none to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; They have become her enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: She sobs through the night; tears stream down her cheeks. Among all her lovers, there is no one left to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her and become her enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: She weeps bitterly in the night, And her tears are on her cheeks; She has no one to comfort her Among all her lovers. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; They have become her enemies.
verses.textEn: Bitterly she weeps at night, tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.

verses.textZh: 犹大受尽痛苦，饱经劳役，更遭流徙异地。 她住在列国中，找不着安居之所。 在困境之中，追赶她的人把她追上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大受尽痛苦，饱经劳役，更遭流徙异地。 她住在列国中，找不着安居之所。 在困境之中，追赶她的人把她追上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大因遭遇苦难， 又因多服劳苦就迁到外邦。 她住在列国中，寻不着安息； 追逼她的都在狭窄之地将她追上。
verses.textEnNiv: After affliction and harsh labor, Judah has gone into exile. She dwells among the nations; she finds no resting place. All who pursue her have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
verses.textEnEsv: Judah has gone into exile because of affliction and hard servitude; she dwells now among the nations, but finds no resting place; her pursuers have all overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah has gone into captivity, Under affliction and hard servitude; She dwells among the nations, She finds no rest; All her persecutors overtake her in dire straits.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah has been led away into captivity, oppressed with cruel slavery. She lives among foreign nations and has no place of rest. Her enemies have chased her down, and she has nowhere to turn.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah has gone into exile out of affliction And harsh servitude; She lives among the nations, But she has not found a resting place; All those who pursued her have overtaken her In the midst of distress.
verses.textEn: After affliction and harsh labor, Judah has gone into exile. She dwells among the nations; she finds no resting place. All who pursue her have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.

verses.textZh: 通往锡安道路悲哀，因为没有人去守节。 锡安一切的城门冷落，祭司唉哼， 处女忧伤，锡安也受尽痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 通往锡安道路悲哀，因为没有人去守节。 锡安一切的城门冷落，祭司唉哼， 处女忧伤，锡安也受尽痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的路径因无人来守圣节就悲伤； 她的城门凄凉； 她的祭司叹息； 她的处女受艰难，自己也愁苦。
verses.textEnNiv: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed festivals. All her gateways are desolate, her priests groan, her young women grieve, and she is in bitter anguish.
verses.textEnEsv: The roads to Zion mourn, for none come to the festival; all her gates are desolate; her priests groan; her virgins have been afflicted, and she herself suffers bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The roads to Zion mourn Because no one comes to the set feasts. All her gates are desolate; Her priests sigh, Her virgins are afflicted, And she is in bitterness.
verses.textEnNlt: The roads to Jerusalem are in mourning, for crowds no longer come to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are silent, her priests groan, her young women are crying— how bitter is her fate!
verses.textEnNasb: The roads of Zion are in mourning Because no one comes to an appointed feast. All her gates are deserted; Her priests groan, Her virgins are worried, And as for Zion herself, it is bitter for her.
verses.textEn: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed festivals. All her gateways are desolate, her priests groan, her young women grieve, and she is in bitter anguish.

verses.textZh: 锡安的敌人成为主人；她的仇敌亨通。 因为她的过犯众多，耶和华就使她受苦。 她的孩童在敌人面前被掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的敌人成为主人；她的仇敌亨通。 因为她的过犯众多，耶和华就使她受苦。 她的孩童在敌人面前被掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的敌人为首； 她的仇敌亨通； 因耶和华为她许多的罪过使她受苦； 她的孩童被敌人掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. The Lord has brought her grief because of her many sins. Her children have gone into exile, captive before the foe.
verses.textEnEsv: Her foes have become the head; her enemies prosper, because the Lord has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions; her children have gone away, captives before the foe.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her adversaries have become the master, Her enemies prosper; For the Lord has afflicted her Because of the multitude of her transgressions. Her children have gone into captivity before the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: Her oppressors have become her masters, and her enemies prosper, for the Lord has punished Jerusalem for her many sins. Her children have been captured and taken away to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: Her adversaries have become her masters, Her enemies are secure; For the Lord has caused her grief Because of the multitude of her wrongdoings; Her little ones have gone away As captives led by the enemy.
verses.textEn: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. The Lord has brought her grief because of her many sins. Her children have gone into exile, captive before the foe.

verses.textZh: 锡安 所有的尊荣，都离开了她的居民。 她的众领袖都像找不着牧场的鹿； 在追赶的人面前无力逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安 所有的尊荣，都离开了她的居民。 她的众领袖都像找不着牧场的鹿； 在追赶的人面前无力逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安城 的威荣全都失去。 她的首领像找不着草场的鹿； 在追赶的人前无力行走。
verses.textEnNiv: All the splendor has departed from Daughter Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; in weakness they have fled before the pursuer.
verses.textEnEsv: From the daughter of Zion all her majesty has departed. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture; they fled without strength before the pursuer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the daughter of Zion All her splendor has departed. Her princes have become like deer That find no pasture, That flee without strength Before the pursuer.
verses.textEnNlt: All the majesty of beautiful Jerusalem has been stripped away. Her princes are like starving deer searching for pasture. They are too weak to run from the pursuing enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: All of her splendor Is gone from the daughter of Zion; Her leaders have become like deer That have found no pasture, And they have fled without strength From the pursuer.
verses.textEn: All the splendor has departed from Daughter Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; in weakness they have fled before the pursuer.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷在困苦飘流的日子，就追念她昔日的一切珍宝。 她的人民落在敌人手里的时候，没有人帮助她。 敌人看见她，就讥笑她的灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷在困苦飘流的日子，就追念她昔日的一切珍宝。 她的人民落在敌人手里的时候，没有人帮助她。 敌人看见她，就讥笑她的灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷在困苦窘迫之时， 就追想古时一切的乐境。 她百姓落在敌人手中，无人救济； 敌人看见，就因她的荒凉嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands, there was no one to help her. Her enemies looked at her and laughed at her destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and wandering all the precious things that were hers from days of old. When her people fell into the hand of the foe, and there was none to help her, her foes gloated over her; they mocked at her downfall.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the days of her affliction and roaming, Jerusalem remembers all her pleasant things That she had in the days of old. When her people fell into the hand of the enemy, With no one to help her, The adversaries saw her And mocked at her downfall.
verses.textEnNlt: In the midst of her sadness and wandering, Jerusalem remembers her ancient splendor. But now she has fallen to her enemy, and there is no one to help her. Her enemy struck her down and laughed as she fell.
verses.textEnNasb: In the days of her affliction and homelessness Jerusalem remembers all her treasures That were hers since the days of old, When her people fell into the hand of the adversary And no one helped her. The adversaries saw her, They laughed at her ruin.
verses.textEn: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands, there was no one to help her. Her enemies looked at her and laughed at her destruction.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷犯了大罪，因此成了不洁之物。 素来尊敬她的现在都藐视她，因为看见她赤身露体； 她自己也唉哼，转身退避。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷犯了大罪，因此成了不洁之物。 素来尊敬她的现在都藐视她，因为看见她赤身露体； 她自己也唉哼，转身退避。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷大大犯罪， 所以成为不洁之物； 素来尊敬她的，见她赤露就都藐视她； 她自己也叹息退后。
verses.textEnNiv: Jerusalem has sinned greatly and so has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, for they have all seen her naked; she herself groans and turns away.
verses.textEnEsv: Jerusalem sinned grievously; therefore she became filthy; all who honored her despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns her face away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jerusalem has sinned gravely, Therefore she has become vile. All who honored her despise her Because they have seen her nakedness; Yes, she sighs and turns away.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem has sinned greatly, so she has been tossed away like a filthy rag. All who once honored her now despise her, for they have seen her stripped naked and humiliated. All she can do is groan and hide her face.
verses.textEnNasb: Jerusalem sinned greatly, Therefore she has become an object of ridicule. All who honored her despise her Because they have seen her nakedness; Even she herself groans and turns away.
verses.textEn: Jerusalem has sinned greatly and so has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, for they have all seen her naked; she herself groans and turns away.

verses.textZh: 她的污秽沾满了衣裙；她从不思想自己的结局。 所以她令人惊异地败落了；没有人安慰她。 她说："耶和华啊！求你看看我的苦难，因为仇敌显为大。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的污秽沾满了衣裙；她从不思想自己的结局。 所以她令人惊异地败落了；没有人安慰她。 她说："耶和华啊！求你看看我的苦难，因为仇敌显为大。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她的污秽是在衣襟上； 她不思想自己的结局， 所以非常地败落， 无人安慰她。 她说：耶和华啊，求你看我的苦难， 因为仇敌夸大。
verses.textEnNiv: Her filthiness clung to her skirts; she did not consider her future. Her fall was astounding; there was none to comfort her. "Look, Lord , on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed."
verses.textEnEsv: Her uncleanness was in her skirts; she took no thought of her future; therefore her fall is terrible; she has no comforter. "O Lord , behold my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Her uncleanness is in her skirts; She did not consider her destiny; Therefore her collapse was awesome; She had no comforter. "O Lord, behold my affliction, For the enemy is exalted!"
verses.textEnNlt: She defiled herself with immorality and gave no thought to her future. Now she lies in the gutter with no one to lift her out. " Lord , see my misery," she cries. "The enemy has triumphed."
verses.textEnNasb: Her uncleanness was in her garment’s seams; She did not think of her future. So she has fallen in an astonishing way; She has no comforter. "See, Lord, my affliction, For the enemy has honored himself!"
verses.textEn: Her filthiness clung to her skirts; she did not consider her future. Her fall was astounding; there was none to comfort her. "Look, Lord , on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed."

verses.textZh: 敌人伸手夺取她的一切珍宝， 她看着外族人闯入她的圣所： 你曾禁止他们进入你的会中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敌人伸手夺取她的一切珍宝， 她看着外族人闯入她的圣所： 你曾禁止他们进入你的会中。
verses.textZhCuv: 敌人伸手，夺取她的美物； 她眼见外邦人进入她的圣所－ 论这外邦人，你曾吩咐不可入你的会中。
verses.textEnNiv: The enemy laid hands on all her treasures; she saw pagan nations enter her sanctuary— those you had forbidden to enter your assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: The enemy has stretched out his hands over all her precious things; for she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary, those whom you forbade to enter your congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: The adversary has spread his hand Over all her pleasant things; For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary, Those whom You commanded Not to enter Your assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: The enemy has plundered her completely, taking every precious thing she owns. She has seen foreigners violate her sacred Temple, the place the Lord had forbidden them to enter.
verses.textEnNasb: The adversary has stretched out his hand Over all her precious things, For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary, The ones whom You commanded That they were not to enter Your congregation.
verses.textEn: The enemy laid hands on all her treasures; she saw pagan nations enter her sanctuary— those you had forbidden to enter your assembly.

verses.textZh: 她所有的人民都在唉哼，到处寻觅食物； 他们为了维持生命，拿自己的珍宝去换取粮食。 她说："耶和华啊！求你垂看，求你鉴察，因为我被人藐视。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她所有的人民都在唉哼，到处寻觅食物； 他们为了维持生命，拿自己的珍宝去换取粮食。 她说："耶和华啊！求你垂看，求你鉴察，因为我被人藐视。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她的民都叹息，寻求食物； 他们用美物换粮食，要救性命。 他们说：耶和华啊，求你观看， 因为我甚是卑贱。
verses.textEnNiv: All her people groan as they search for bread; they barter their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. "Look, Lord , and consider, for I am despised."
verses.textEnEsv: All her people groan as they search for bread; they trade their treasures for food to revive their strength. "Look, O Lord , and see, for I am despised."
verses.textEnNkjv: All her people sigh, They seek bread; They have given their valuables for food to restore life. "See, O Lord, and consider, For I am scorned."
verses.textEnNlt: Her people groan as they search for bread. They have sold their treasures for food to stay alive. "O Lord , look," she mourns, "and see how I am despised.
verses.textEnNasb: All her people groan, seeking bread; They have given their treasures for food To restore their lives. "See, Lord, and look, For I am despised."
verses.textEn: All her people groan as they search for bread; they barter their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. "Look, Lord , and consider, for I am despised."

verses.textZh: 所有过路的人啊！你们毫不在意吗？ 你们要细察要观看，有没有痛苦像我所受的痛苦， 就是耶和华在他发烈怒的日子使我所受的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有过路的人啊！你们毫不在意吗？ 你们要细察要观看，有没有痛苦像我所受的痛苦， 就是耶和华在他发烈怒的日子使我所受的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们一切过路的人哪，这事你们不介意吗？ 你们要观看： 有像这临到我的痛苦没有－ 就是耶和华在他发烈怒的日子使我所受的苦？
verses.textEnNiv: "Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see. Is any suffering like my suffering that was inflicted on me, that the Lord brought on me in the day of his fierce anger?
verses.textEnEsv: "Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which was brought upon me, which the Lord inflicted on the day of his fierce anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Isit nothing to you, all you who pass by? Behold and see If there is any sorrow like my sorrow, Which has been brought on me, Which the Lord has inflicted In the day of His fierce anger.
verses.textEnNlt: "Does it mean nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see if there is any suffering like mine, which the Lord brought on me when he erupted in fierce anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it nothing to all you who pass this way? Look and see if there is any pain like my pain Which was inflicted on me, With which the Lord tormented me on the day of His fierce anger.
verses.textEn: "Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see. Is any suffering like my suffering that was inflicted on me, that the Lord brought on me in the day of his fierce anger?

verses.textZh: 他从高天降火，使火进入我的骨头里 。 他设置网罗绊我的脚，使我退去。 他使我孤单凄凉，终日愁烦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从高天降火，使火进入我的骨头里 。 他设置网罗绊我的脚，使我退去。 他使我孤单凄凉，终日愁烦。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从高天使火进入我的骨头， 克制了我； 他铺下网罗，绊我的脚， 使我转回； 他使我终日凄凉发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: "From on high he sent fire, sent it down into my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
verses.textEnEsv: "From on high he sent fire; into my bones he made it descend; he spread a net for my feet; he turned me back; he has left me stunned, faint all the day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: "From above He has sent fire into my bones, And it overpowered them; He has spread a net for my feet And turned me back; He has made me desolate And faint all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: "He has sent fire from heaven that burns in my bones. He has placed a trap in my path and turned me back. He has left me devastated, racked with sickness all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the height He sent fire into my bones, And it dominated them. He has spread a net for my feet; He has turned me back; He has made me desolate, Faint all day long.
verses.textEn: "From on high he sent fire, sent it down into my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.

verses.textZh: 我的过犯像轭一样被绑好；是他亲手缠绑的。 我的过犯加在我的颈上，他使我的气力衰弱。 主把我交在我不能对抗的人手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的过犯像轭一样被绑好；是他亲手缠绑的。 我的过犯加在我的颈上，他使我的气力衰弱。 主把我交在我不能对抗的人手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我罪过的轭是他手所绑的， 犹如轭绳缚在我颈项上； 他使我的力量衰败。 主将我交在我所不能敌挡的人手中。
verses.textEnNiv: "My sins have been bound into a yoke ; by his hands they were woven together. They have been hung on my neck, and the Lord has sapped my strength. He has given me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
verses.textEnEsv: "My transgressions were bound into a yoke; by his hand they were fastened together; they were set upon my neck; he caused my strength to fail; the Lord gave me into the hands of those whom I cannot withstand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The yoke of my transgressions was bound; They were woven together by His hands, And thrust upon my neck. He made my strength fail; The Lord delivered me into the hands of thosewhom I am not able to withstand.
verses.textEnNlt: "He wove my sins into ropes to hitch me to a yoke of captivity. The Lord sapped my strength and turned me over to my enemies; I am helpless in their hands.
verses.textEnNasb: "The yoke of my wrongdoings is bound; By His hand they are woven together. They have come upon my neck; He has made my strength fail. The Lord has handed me over To those against whom I am not able to stand.
verses.textEn: "My sins have been bound into a yoke ; by his hands they were woven together. They have been hung on my neck, and the Lord has sapped my strength. He has given me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.

verses.textZh: 主丢弃我中间的所有勇士； 他招聚了一大群人来攻击我，要打碎我的青年人。 主践踏犹大女儿中的处女，像践踏压酒池一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主丢弃我中间的所有勇士； 他招聚了一大群人来攻击我，要打碎我的青年人。 主践踏犹大女儿中的处女，像践踏压酒池一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 主轻弃我中间的一切勇士， 招聚多人 攻击我， 要压碎我的少年人。 主将犹大居民踹下， 像在酒榨中一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord has rejected all the warriors in my midst; he has summoned an army against me to crush my young men. In his winepress the Lord has trampled Virgin Daughter Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord rejected all my mighty men in my midst; he summoned an assembly against me to crush my young men; the Lord has trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord has trampled underfoot all my mighty men in my midst; He has called an assembly against me To crush my young men; The Lord trampled as in a winepress The virgin daughter of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord has treated my mighty men with contempt. At his command a great army has come to crush my young warriors. The Lord has trampled his beloved city like grapes are trampled in a winepress.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord has thrown away all my strong men In my midst; He has called an appointed time against me To crush my young men; The Lord has trodden as in a wine press The virgin daughter of Judah.
verses.textEn: "The Lord has rejected all the warriors in my midst; he has summoned an army against me to crush my young men. In his winepress the Lord has trampled Virgin Daughter Judah.

verses.textZh: 为了这些事我不住哭泣，我的眼不住流下泪水； 因为那安慰我、使我重新振作的，都远离了我。 我的儿女孤单凄凉，因为仇敌得胜了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这些事我不住哭泣，我的眼不住流下泪水； 因为那安慰我、使我重新振作的，都远离了我。 我的儿女孤单凄凉，因为仇敌得胜了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因这些事哭泣； 我眼泪汪汪； 因为那当安慰我、救我性命的， 离我甚远。 我的儿女孤苦， 因为仇敌得了胜。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is why I weep and my eyes overflow with tears. No one is near to comfort me, no one to restore my spirit. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed."
verses.textEnEsv: "For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears; for a comforter is far from me, one to revive my spirit; my children are desolate, for the enemy has prevailed."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For these things I weep; My eye, my eye overflows with water; Because the comforter, who should restore my life, Is far from me. My children are desolate Because the enemy prevailed."
verses.textEnNlt: "For all these things I weep; tears flow down my cheeks. No one is here to comfort me; any who might encourage me are far away. My children have no future, for the enemy has conquered us."
verses.textEnNasb: "For these things I weep; My eyes run down with water; Because far from me is a comforter, One to restore my soul. My children are desolate Because the enemy has prevailed."
verses.textEn: "This is why I weep and my eyes overflow with tears. No one is near to comfort me, no one to restore my spirit. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed."

verses.textZh: 锡安伸出双手，但没有人安慰她。 论到雅各，耶和华已经下令，使他四围的人都与他为敌； 耶路撒冷在他们中间，已经成了不洁的东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安伸出双手，但没有人安慰她。 论到雅各，耶和华已经下令，使他四围的人都与他为敌； 耶路撒冷在他们中间，已经成了不洁的东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安举手，无人安慰。 耶和华论雅各已经出令， 使四围的人作他仇敌； 耶路撒冷在他们中间像不洁之物。
verses.textEnNiv: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The Lord has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
verses.textEnEsv: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is none to comfort her; the Lord has commanded against Jacob that his neighbors should be his foes; Jerusalem has become a filthy thing among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zion spreads out her hands, But no one comforts her; The Lord has commanded concerning Jacob That those around him become his adversaries; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem reaches out for help, but no one comforts her. Regarding his people Israel, the Lord has said, "Let their neighbors be their enemies! Let them be thrown away like a filthy rag!"
verses.textEnNasb: Zion stretches out with her hands; There is no one to comfort her; The Lord has commanded regarding Jacob That those around him become his adversaries; Jerusalem has become a filthy thing among them.
verses.textEn: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The Lord has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是公义的，他这样待我，是因为我违背了他的命令。 万民哪！请你们听我的话！看看我的痛苦！ 我的少女和青年人都已经被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是公义的，他这样待我，是因为我违背了他的命令。 万民哪！请你们听我的话！看看我的痛苦！ 我的少女和青年人都已经被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是公义的！ 他这样待我，是因我违背他的命令。 众民哪，请听我的话， 看我的痛苦； 我的处女和少年人都被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord is righteous, yet I rebelled against his command. Listen, all you peoples; look on my suffering. My young men and young women have gone into exile.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord is in the right, for I have rebelled against his word; but hear, all you peoples, and see my suffering; my young women and my young men have gone into captivity.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord is righteous, For I rebelled against His commandment. Hear now, all peoples, And behold my sorrow; My virgins and my young men Have gone into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord is right," Jerusalem says, "for I rebelled against him. Listen, people everywhere; look upon my anguish and despair, for my sons and daughters have been taken captive to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord is righteous, For I have rebelled against His command; Hear now, all peoples, And see my pain; My virgins and my young men Have gone into captivity.
verses.textEn: "The Lord is righteous, yet I rebelled against his command. Listen, all you peoples; look on my suffering. My young men and young women have gone into exile.

verses.textZh: 我向我所爱的人呼求，他们却欺骗我。 我的祭司和长老为了延续生命，寻找粮食的时候， 就在城中气绝身亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向我所爱的人呼求，他们却欺骗我。 我的祭司和长老为了延续生命，寻找粮食的时候， 就在城中气绝身亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我招呼我所亲爱的， 他们却愚弄我。 我的祭司和长老正寻求食物、救性命的时候， 就在城中绝气。
verses.textEnNiv: "I called to my allies but they betrayed me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
verses.textEnEsv: "I called to my lovers, but they deceived me; my priests and elders perished in the city, while they sought food to revive their strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I called for my lovers, But they deceived me; My priests and my elders Breathed their last in the city, While they sought food To restore their life.
verses.textEnNlt: "I begged my allies for help, but they betrayed me. My priests and leaders starved to death in the city, even as they searched for food to save their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: "I called to my lovers, but they deserted me; My priests and my elders perished in the city While they sought food to restore their strength themselves.
verses.textEn: "I called to my allies but they betrayed me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你看，患难临到我！我的心肠激动， 我的心在我里面翻转，因为我曾经非常悖逆。 街上有刀剑使人丧子，屋里也有死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你看，患难临到我！我的心肠激动， 我的心在我里面翻转，因为我曾经非常悖逆。 街上有刀剑使人丧子，屋里也有死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你观看， 因为我在急难中。 我心肠扰乱； 我心在我里面翻转， 因我大大悖逆。 在外，刀剑使人丧子； 在家，犹如死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, Lord , how distressed I am! I am in torment within, and in my heart I am disturbed, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is only death.
verses.textEnEsv: "Look, O Lord , for I am in distress; my stomach churns; my heart is wrung within me, because I have been very rebellious. In the street the sword bereaves; in the house it is like death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "See, O Lord, that I am in distress; My soul is troubled; My heart is overturned within me, For I have been very rebellious. Outside the sword bereaves, At home itis like death.
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , see my anguish! My heart is broken and my soul despairs, for I have rebelled against you. In the streets the sword kills, and at home there is only death.
verses.textEnNasb: "See, Lord, for I am in distress; My spirit is greatly troubled; My heart is overturned within me, For I have been very rebellious. In the street the sword has made women childless; In the house it is like death.
verses.textEn: "See, Lord , how distressed I am! I am in torment within, and in my heart I am disturbed, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is only death.

verses.textZh: 有人听见我的唉哼，却没有人安慰我， 我所有的仇敌都听见我的灾难；你作了这事，他们就欢乐。 愿你使你所宣告的日子来临那时，他们就必像我一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人听见我的唉哼，却没有人安慰我， 我所有的仇敌都听见我的灾难；你作了这事，他们就欢乐。 愿你使你所宣告的日子来临那时，他们就必像我一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 听见我叹息的有人； 安慰我的却无人！ 我的仇敌都听见我所遭的患难； 因你做这事，他们都喜乐。 你必使你报告的日子来到， 他们就像我一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they rejoice at what you have done. May you bring the day you have announced so they may become like me.
verses.textEnEsv: "They heard my groaning, yet there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it. You have brought the day you announced; now let them be as I am.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They have heard that I sigh, But no one comforts me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; They are glad that You have done it. Bring on the day You have announced, That they may become like me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Others heard my groans, but no one turned to comfort me. When my enemies heard about my troubles, they were happy to see what you had done. Oh, bring the day you promised, when they will suffer as I have suffered.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have heard that I groan; There is no one to comfort me, All my enemies have heard of my disaster; They are joyful that You have done it. Oh, that You would bring the day which You have proclaimed, So that they will become like me.
verses.textEn: "People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they rejoice at what you have done. May you bring the day you have announced so they may become like me.

verses.textZh: 愿他们的一切恶行都摆在你面前，愿你对付他们， 好象你因我的一切过犯对付我一样。 因为我唉哼甚苦，我心里愁烦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的一切恶行都摆在你面前，愿你对付他们， 好象你因我的一切过犯对付我一样。 因为我唉哼甚苦，我心里愁烦。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们的恶行都呈在你面前； 你怎样因我的一切罪过待我， 求你照样待他们； 因我叹息甚多，心中发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let all their wickedness come before you; deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my sins. My groans are many and my heart is faint."
verses.textEnEsv: "Let all their evildoing come before you, and deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my transgressions; for my groans are many, and my heart is faint."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let all their wickedness come before You, And do to them as You have done to me For all my transgressions; For my sighs are many, And my heart is faint."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at all their evil deeds, Lord . Punish them, as you have punished me for all my sins. My groans are many, and I am sick at heart."
verses.textEnNasb: "May all their wickedness come before You; And deal with them just as You have dealt with me For all my wrongdoings. For my groans are many and my heart is faint."
verses.textEn: "Let all their wickedness come before you; deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my sins. My groans are many and my heart is faint."

verses.textZh: 主在烈怒中，怎么竟然使黑云遮盖锡安的居民 ！ 他把以色列的荣美，从天上拋到地上； 他在发怒的日子，竟不记念自己的脚凳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主在烈怒中，怎么竟然使黑云遮盖锡安的居民 ！ 他把以色列的荣美，从天上拋到地上； 他在发怒的日子，竟不记念自己的脚凳。
verses.textZhCuv: 主何竟发怒，使黑云遮蔽锡安城！ 他将以色列的华美从天扔在地上； 在他发怒的日子并不记念自己的脚凳。
verses.textEnNiv: How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion with the cloud of his anger ! He has hurled down the splendor of Israel from heaven to earth; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: How the Lord in his anger has set the daughter of Zion under a cloud! He has cast down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion With a cloud in His anger! He cast down from heaven to the earth The beauty of Israel, And did not remember His footstool In the day of His anger.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord in his anger has cast a dark shadow over beautiful Jerusalem. The fairest of Israel’s cities lies in the dust, thrown down from the heights of heaven. In his day of great anger, the Lord has shown no mercy even to his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion With a cloud in His anger! He has hurled The glory of Israel from heaven to earth, And has not remembered His footstool In the day of His anger.
verses.textEn: How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion with the cloud of his anger ! He has hurled down the splendor of Israel from heaven to earth; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

verses.textZh: 主吞灭了雅各所有住处，毫不顾惜； 他在忿怒中，把犹大居民的坚固城拆毁； 他使国家和国中众领袖都倒在地上，受尽羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主吞灭了雅各所有住处，毫不顾惜； 他在忿怒中，把犹大居民的坚固城拆毁； 他使国家和国中众领袖都倒在地上，受尽羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 主吞灭雅各一切的住处，并不顾惜。 他发怒倾覆犹大民的保障， 使这保障坍倒在地； 他辱没这国和其中的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of Daughter Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground in dishonor.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has swallowed up without mercy all the habitations of Jacob; in his wrath he has broken down the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; he has brought down to the ground in dishonor the kingdom and its rulers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has swallowed up and has not pitied All the dwelling places of Jacob. He has thrown down in His wrath The strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought them down to the ground; He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
verses.textEnNlt: Without mercy the Lord has destroyed every home in Israel. In his anger he has broken down the fortress walls of beautiful Jerusalem. He has brought them to the ground, dishonoring the kingdom and its rulers.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has destroyed; He has not spared All the settlements of Jacob. In His wrath He has overthrown The strongholds of the daughter of Judah, He has hurled them down to the ground; He has profaned the kingdom and its leaders.
verses.textEn: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of Daughter Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground in dishonor.

verses.textZh: 他在烈怒中砍断以色列所有的角； 他从仇敌面前，收回自己的右手。 他像吞灭四周物件的火焰，在雅各中间焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在烈怒中砍断以色列所有的角； 他从仇敌面前，收回自己的右手。 他像吞灭四周物件的火焰，在雅各中间焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 他发烈怒，把以色列的角全然砍断， 在仇敌面前收回右手。 他像火焰四围吞灭，将雅各烧毁。
verses.textEnNiv: In fierce anger he has cut off every horn of Israel. He has withdrawn his right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
verses.textEnEsv: He has cut down in fierce anger all the might of Israel; he has withdrawn from them his right hand in the face of the enemy; he has burned like a flaming fire in Jacob, consuming all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has cut off in fierce anger Every horn of Israel; He has drawn back His right hand From before the enemy. He has blazed against Jacob like a flaming fire Devouring all around.
verses.textEnNlt: All the strength of Israel vanishes beneath his fierce anger. The Lord has withdrawn his protection as the enemy attacks. He consumes the whole land of Israel like a raging fire.
verses.textEnNasb: In fierce anger He has cut off All the strength of Israel; He has pulled back His right hand From the enemy. And He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire Consuming on all sides.
verses.textEn: In fierce anger he has cut off every horn of Israel. He has withdrawn his right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.

verses.textZh: 他像仇敌拉弓，他的右手已经预备好。 他像敌人把一切悦人眼目的都杀灭了； 他如火的忿怒倒在锡安居民 的帐棚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他像仇敌拉弓，他的右手已经预备好。 他像敌人把一切悦人眼目的都杀灭了； 他如火的忿怒倒在锡安居民 的帐棚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他张弓好像仇敌； 他站着举起右手， 如同敌人将悦人眼目的，尽行杀戮。 在锡安百姓的帐棚上 倒出他的忿怒，像火一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Like an enemy he has strung his bow; his right hand is ready. Like a foe he has slain all who were pleasing to the eye; he has poured out his wrath like fire on the tent of Daughter Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: He has bent his bow like an enemy, with his right hand set like a foe; and he has killed all who were delightful in our eyes; in the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his fury like fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Standing like an enemy, He has bent His bow; With His right hand, like an adversary, He has slain all whowere pleasing to His eye; On the tent of the daughter of Zion, He has poured out His fury like fire.
verses.textEnNlt: He bends his bow against his people, as though he were their enemy. His strength is used against them to kill their finest youth. His fury is poured out like fire on beautiful Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned like an adversary, And He has killed everything that was pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion He has poured out His wrath like fire.
verses.textEn: Like an enemy he has strung his bow; his right hand is ready. Like a foe he has slain all who were pleasing to the eye; he has poured out his wrath like fire on the tent of Daughter Zion.

verses.textZh: 主好象成了仇敌； 他吞灭了以色列和她所有的宫殿，毁坏了她的坚固城。 他在犹大居民的中间，增添了悲哀和哭号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主好象成了仇敌； 他吞灭了以色列和她所有的宫殿，毁坏了她的坚固城。 他在犹大居民的中间，增添了悲哀和哭号。
verses.textZhCuv: 主如仇敌吞灭以色列和锡安的一切宫殿， 拆毁百姓的保障； 在犹大民中加增悲伤哭号。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for Daughter Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has become like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel; he has swallowed up all its palaces; he has laid in ruins its strongholds, and he has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord was like an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel, He has swallowed up all her palaces; He has destroyed her strongholds, And has increased mourning and lamentation In the daughter of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the Lord has vanquished Israel like an enemy. He has destroyed her palaces and demolished her fortresses. He has brought unending sorrow and tears upon beautiful Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has become like an enemy. He has engulfed Israel; He has engulfed all its palaces, He has destroyed its strongholds And caused great mourning and grieving in the daughter of Judah.
verses.textEn: The Lord is like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for Daughter Judah.

verses.textZh: 他把自己的住所破坏，好象园子一样； 他毁坏了属他的聚会之处。 耶和华使节期和安息日都在锡安被忘记； 他在他的盛怒中弃绝了君王和祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把自己的住所破坏，好象园子一样； 他毁坏了属他的聚会之处。 耶和华使节期和安息日都在锡安被忘记； 他在他的盛怒中弃绝了君王和祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 他强取自己的帐幕，好像是园中的窝棚， 毁坏他的聚会之处。 耶和华使圣节和安息日在锡安都被忘记， 又在怒气的愤恨中藐视君王和祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: He has laid waste his dwelling like a garden; he has destroyed his place of meeting. The Lord has made Zion forget her appointed festivals and her Sabbaths; in his fierce anger he has spurned both king and priest.
verses.textEnEsv: He has laid waste his booth like a garden, laid in ruins his meeting place; the Lord has made Zion forget festival and Sabbath, and in his fierce indignation has spurned king and priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has done violence to His tabernacle, Asifitwere a garden; He has destroyed His place of assembly; The Lord has caused The appointed feasts and Sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion. In His burning indignation He has spurned the king and the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: He has broken down his Temple as though it were merely a garden shelter. The Lord has blotted out all memory of the holy festivals and Sabbath days. Kings and priests fall together before his fierce anger.
verses.textEnNasb: And He has treated His tabernacle violently, like a despised garden; He has destroyed His appointed meeting place. The Lord has caused The appointed feast and Sabbath in Zion to be forgotten, And He has despised king and priest In the indignation of His anger.
verses.textEn: He has laid waste his dwelling like a garden; he has destroyed his place of meeting. The Lord has made Zion forget her appointed festivals and her Sabbaths; in his fierce anger he has spurned both king and priest.

verses.textZh: 主丢弃了自己的祭坛，厌弃了自己的圣所。 他把宫殿的围墙，交付在仇敌的手里； 他们在耶和华的殿中喧嚷，好象庆祝节日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主丢弃了自己的祭坛，厌弃了自己的圣所。 他把宫殿的围墙，交付在仇敌的手里； 他们在耶和华的殿中喧嚷，好象庆祝节日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华丢弃自己的祭坛， 憎恶自己的圣所， 将宫殿的墙垣交付仇敌。 他们在耶和华的殿中喧嚷， 像在圣会之日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hands of the enemy; they have raised a shout in the house of the Lord as on the day of an appointed festival.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has scorned his altar, disowned his sanctuary; he has delivered into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they raised a clamor in the house of the Lord as on the day of festival.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has spurned His altar, He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has given up the walls of her palaces Into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in the house of the Lord As on the day of a set feast.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has rejected his own altar; he despises his own sanctuary. He has given Jerusalem’s palaces to her enemies. They shout in the Lord ’s Temple as though it were a day of celebration.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has rejected His altar, He has repudiated His sanctuary; He has handed over The walls of her palaces to the enemy. They have made a noise in the house of the Lord As on the day of an appointed feast.
verses.textEn: The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hands of the enemy; they have raised a shout in the house of the Lord as on the day of an appointed festival.

verses.textZh: 耶和华定意要拆毁锡安居民 的城墙； 他拉了准绳，决不停手，务要把它吞灭。 他使堡垒和城墙都悲哀，一同受痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华定意要拆毁锡安居民 的城墙； 他拉了准绳，决不停手，务要把它吞灭。 他使堡垒和城墙都悲哀，一同受痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华定意拆毁锡安的城墙； 他拉了准绳， 不将手收回，定要毁灭。 他使外郭和城墙都悲哀， 一同衰败。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord determined to tear down the wall around Daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withhold his hand from destroying. He made ramparts and walls lament; together they wasted away.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord determined to lay in ruins the wall of the daughter of Zion; he stretched out the measuring line; he did not restrain his hand from destroying; he caused rampart and wall to lament; they languished together.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has purposed to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out a line; He has not withdrawn His hand from destroying; Therefore He has caused the rampart and wall to lament; They languished together.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was determined to destroy the walls of beautiful Jerusalem. He made careful plans for their destruction, then did what he had planned. Therefore, the ramparts and walls have fallen down before him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord determined to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out a line, He has not restrained His hand from destroying, And He has caused rampart and wall to mourn; They have languished together.
verses.textEn: The Lord determined to tear down the wall around Daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withhold his hand from destroying. He made ramparts and walls lament; together they wasted away.

verses.textZh: 锡安的众城门已经陷入地里；耶和华把锡安的门闩都毁坏折断了。 锡安的君王和领袖都身在列国中；锡安再没有律法了； 它的众先知也得不到从耶和华而来的异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的众城门已经陷入地里；耶和华把锡安的门闩都毁坏折断了。 锡安的君王和领袖都身在列国中；锡安再没有律法了； 它的众先知也得不到从耶和华而来的异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的门都陷入地内； 主将她的门闩毁坏，折断。 她的君王和首领落在没有律法的列国中； 她的先知不得见耶和华的异象。
verses.textEnNiv: Her gates have sunk into the ground; their bars he has broken and destroyed. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and her prophets no longer find visions from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Her gates have sunk into the ground; he has ruined and broken her bars; her king and princes are among the nations; the law is no more, and her prophets find no vision from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations; The Law is no more, And her prophets find no vision from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem’s gates have sunk into the ground. He has smashed their locks and bars. Her kings and princes have been exiled to distant lands; her law has ceased to exist. Her prophets receive no more visions from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Her gates have sunk into the ground, He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her leaders are among the nations; The Law is gone. Her prophets, too, find No vision from the Lord.
verses.textEn: Her gates have sunk into the ground; their bars he has broken and destroyed. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and her prophets no longer find visions from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 锡安居民 的长老都坐在地上，默默无声； 他们把尘灰撒在头上，腰束麻布。 耶路撒冷的处女都垂头至地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安居民 的长老都坐在地上，默默无声； 他们把尘灰撒在头上，腰束麻布。 耶路撒冷的处女都垂头至地。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安城的长老坐在地上默默无声； 他们扬起尘土落在头上，腰束麻布； 耶路撒冷的处女垂头至地。
verses.textEnNiv: The elders of Daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have sprinkled dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth; the young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion Sit on the ground and keep silence; They throw dust on their heads And gird themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem Bow their heads to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of beautiful Jerusalem sit on the ground in silence. They are clothed in burlap and throw dust on their heads. The young women of Jerusalem hang their heads in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: The elders of the daughter of Zion Sit on the ground and are silent. They have thrown dust on their heads; They have put on sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem Have bowed their heads to the ground.
verses.textEn: The elders of Daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have sprinkled dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

verses.textZh: 我的眼睛因流泪而失明，我的心肠激动， 我的肝胆倾倒在地，都因我的子民 遭毁灭， 孩童和婴儿在城里的街上昏倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼睛因流泪而失明，我的心肠激动， 我的肝胆倾倒在地，都因我的子民 遭毁灭， 孩童和婴儿在城里的街上昏倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我眼中流泪，以致失明； 我的心肠扰乱，肝胆涂地， 都因我众民遭毁灭， 又因孩童和吃奶的在城内街上发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes fail from weeping, I am in torment within; my heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes are spent with weeping; my stomach churns; my bile is poured out to the ground because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because infants and babies faint in the streets of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes fail with tears, My heart is troubled; My bile is poured on the ground Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the children and the infants Faint in the streets of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: I have cried until the tears no longer come; my heart is broken. My spirit is poured out in agony as I see the desperate plight of my people. Little children and tiny babies are fainting and dying in the streets.
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes fail because of tears, My spirit is greatly troubled; My heart is poured out on the earth Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, When little ones and infants languish In the streets of the city.
verses.textEn: My eyes fail from weeping, I am in torment within; my heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.

verses.textZh: 他们像被刺伤的人昏倒在城里街上的时候， 他们在母亲的怀里快要丧命的时候， 他们就问母亲："五谷和酒在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们像被刺伤的人昏倒在城里街上的时候， 他们在母亲的怀里快要丧命的时候， 他们就问母亲："五谷和酒在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他们在城内街上发昏，好像受伤的， 在母亲的怀里，将要丧命； 对母亲说：谷、酒在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: They say to their mothers, "Where is bread and wine?" as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives ebb away in their mothers’ arms.
verses.textEnEsv: They cry to their mothers, "Where is bread and wine?" as they faint like a wounded man in the streets of the city, as their life is poured out on their mothers’ bosom.
verses.textEnNkjv: They say to their mothers, "Where is grain and wine?" As they swoon like the wounded In the streets of the city, As their life is poured out In their mothers’ bosom.
verses.textEnNlt: They cry out to their mothers, "We need food and drink!" Their lives ebb away in the streets like the life of a warrior wounded in battle. They gasp for life as they collapse in their mothers’ arms.
verses.textEnNasb: They say to their mothers, "Where is grain and wine?" As they faint like a wounded person In the streets of the city, As their lives are poured out In their mothers’ arms.
verses.textEn: They say to their mothers, "Where is bread and wine?" as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives ebb away in their mothers’ arms.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的居民哪，我怎样向你说明呢？用甚么与你比较呢？ 锡安的居民哪，我们用甚么跟你相比，好安慰你呢？ 你的裂口像海那样大，谁能医治你呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的居民哪，我怎样向你说明呢？用甚么与你比较呢？ 锡安的居民哪，我们用甚么跟你相比，好安慰你呢？ 你的裂口像海那样大，谁能医治你呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的民哪，我可用什么向你证明呢？ 我可用什么与你相比呢？ 锡安的民哪，我可拿什么和你比较，好安慰你呢？ 因为你的裂口大如海， 谁能医治你呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What can I say for you? With what can I compare you, Daughter Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, Virgin Daughter Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?
verses.textEnEsv: What can I say for you, to what compare you, O daughter of Jerusalem? What can I liken to you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? For your ruin is vast as the sea; who can heal you?
verses.textEnNkjv: How shall I console you? To what shall I liken you, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare with you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? For your ruin is spread wide as the sea; Who can heal you?
verses.textEnNlt: What can I say about you? Who has ever seen such sorrow? O daughter of Jerusalem, to what can I compare your anguish? O virgin daughter of Zion, how can I comfort you? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?
verses.textEnNasb: How shall I admonish you? What shall I compare to you, Daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I liken to you as I comfort you, Virgin daughter of Zion? For your collapse is as vast as the sea; Who can heal you?
verses.textEn: What can I say for you? With what can I compare you, Daughter Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, Virgin Daughter Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?

verses.textZh: 你的假先知为了你所见的异象， 尽是虚谎和愚昧； 他们没有显露你的罪孽，使你的命运得以挽回； 他们为你所得的默示，全是虚谎，是引人走错路的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的假先知为了你所见的异象， 尽是虚谎和愚昧； 他们没有显露你的罪孽，使你的命运得以挽回； 他们为你所得的默示，全是虚谎，是引人走错路的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的先知为你见虚假和愚昧的异象， 并没有显露你的罪孽， 使你被掳的归回； 却为你见虚假的默示 和使你被赶出本境的缘故。
verses.textEnNiv: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless; they did not expose your sin to ward off your captivity. The prophecies they gave you were false and misleading.
verses.textEnEsv: Your prophets have seen for you false and deceptive visions; they have not exposed your iniquity to restore your fortunes, but have seen for you oracles that are false and misleading.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your prophets have seen for you False and deceptive visions; They have not uncovered your iniquity, To bring back your captives, But have envisioned for you false prophecies and delusions.
verses.textEnNlt: Your prophets have said so many foolish things, false to the core. They did not save you from exile by pointing out your sins. Instead, they painted false pictures, filling you with false hope.
verses.textEnNasb: Your prophets have seen for you Worthless and deceptive visions; And they have not exposed your wrongdoing So as to restore you from captivity, But they have seen for you worthless and misleading pronouncements.
verses.textEn: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless; they did not expose your sin to ward off your captivity. The prophecies they gave you were false and misleading.

verses.textZh: 所有过路的人，都拍掌嘲笑你； 他们嗤笑耶路撒冷的居民，并摇头说： "被人称为最完美，为全地所喜悦的，就是这城吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有过路的人，都拍掌嘲笑你； 他们嗤笑耶路撒冷的居民，并摇头说： "被人称为最完美，为全地所喜悦的，就是这城吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡过路的都向你拍掌。 他们向耶路撒冷城嗤笑，摇头，说： 难道人所称为全美的， 称为全地所喜悦的，就是这城吗？
verses.textEnNiv: All who pass your way clap their hands at you; they scoff and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: "Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?"
verses.textEnEsv: All who pass along the way clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?"
verses.textEnNkjv: All who pass by clap their hands at you; They hiss and shake their heads At the daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city that is called ‘The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth’?"
verses.textEnNlt: All who pass by jeer at you. They scoff and insult beautiful Jerusalem, saying, "Is this the city called ‘Most Beautiful in All the World’ and ‘Joy of All the Earth’?"
verses.textEnNasb: All who pass along the way Clap their hands in ridicule at you; They hiss and shake their heads At the daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city of which they said, ‘Perfect in beauty, A joy to all the earth’?"
verses.textEn: All who pass your way clap their hands at you; they scoff and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: "Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?"

verses.textZh: 你所有的仇敌都张开口攻击你， 他们嗤笑你，又咬牙切齿，说："我们吞灭它了！ 这真是我们期待的日子！我们等到了！亲眼看见了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所有的仇敌都张开口攻击你， 他们嗤笑你，又咬牙切齿，说："我们吞灭它了！ 这真是我们期待的日子！我们等到了！亲眼看见了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的仇敌都向你大大张口； 他们嗤笑，又切齿说： 我们吞灭她。 这真是我们所盼望的日子临到了！ 我们亲眼看见了！
verses.textEnNiv: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you; they scoff and gnash their teeth and say, "We have swallowed her up. This is the day we have waited for; we have lived to see it."
verses.textEnEsv: All your enemies rail against you; they hiss, they gnash their teeth, they cry: "We have swallowed her! Ah, this is the day we longed for; now we have it; we see it!"
verses.textEnNkjv: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you; They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, "We have swallowed her up! Surely this is the day we have waited for; We have found it, we have seen it!"
verses.textEnNlt: All your enemies mock you. They scoff and snarl and say, "We have destroyed her at last! We have long waited for this day, and it is finally here!"
verses.textEnNasb: All your enemies Have opened their mouths wide against you; They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, "We have engulfed her! This certainly is the day which we awaited; We have reached it, we have seen it!"
verses.textEn: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you; they scoff and gnash their teeth and say, "We have swallowed her up. This is the day we have waited for; we have lived to see it."

verses.textZh: 耶和华作成了他定意去作的，成就了他的话， 就是他昔日所宣告的，他把你拆毁，并不怜惜， 他使仇敌因胜过你而高兴，他高举你敌人的角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华作成了他定意去作的，成就了他的话， 就是他昔日所宣告的，他把你拆毁，并不怜惜， 他使仇敌因胜过你而高兴，他高举你敌人的角。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华成就了他所定的， 应验了他古时所命定的。 他倾覆了，并不顾惜， 使你的仇敌向你夸耀； 使你敌人的角也被高举。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago. He has overthrown you without pity, he has let the enemy gloat over you, he has exalted the horn of your foes.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has done what he purposed; he has carried out his word, which he commanded long ago; he has thrown down without pity; he has made the enemy rejoice over you and exalted the might of your foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has done what He purposed; He has fulfilled His word Which He commanded in days of old. He has thrown down and has not pitied, And He has caused an enemy to rejoice over you; He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
verses.textEnNlt: But it is the Lord who did just as he planned. He has fulfilled the promises of disaster he made long ago. He has destroyed Jerusalem without mercy. He has caused her enemies to gloat over her and has given them power over her.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has done what He determined; He has accomplished His word Which He commanded from days of old. He has torn down without sparing, And He has helped the enemy to rejoice over you; He has exalted the might of your adversaries.
verses.textEn: The Lord has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago. He has overthrown you without pity, he has let the enemy gloat over you, he has exalted the horn of your foes.

verses.textZh: 锡安居民 的城墙啊，你要一心向主哀求； 愿你的眼泪像江河般涌流，昼夜不息； 愿你得不着歇息，愿你眼中的瞳人不能休息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安居民 的城墙啊，你要一心向主哀求； 愿你的眼泪像江河般涌流，昼夜不息； 愿你得不着歇息，愿你眼中的瞳人不能休息。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安民的心哀求主。 锡安的城墙啊，愿你流泪如河， 昼夜不息； 愿你眼中的瞳人泪流不止。
verses.textEnNiv: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. You walls of Daughter Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night; give yourself no relief, your eyes no rest.
verses.textEnEsv: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears stream down like a torrent day and night! Give yourself no rest, your eyes no respite!
verses.textEnNkjv: Their heart cried out to the Lord, "O wall of the daughter of Zion, Let tears run down like a river day and night; Give yourself no relief; Give your eyes no rest.
verses.textEnNlt: Cry aloud before the Lord, O walls of beautiful Jerusalem! Let your tears flow like a river day and night. Give yourselves no rest; give your eyes no relief.
verses.textEnNasb: Their heart cried out to the Lord: "You wall of the daughter of Zion, Let your tears stream down like a river day and night; Give yourself no relief, Let your eyes have no rest.
verses.textEn: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. You walls of Daughter Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night; give yourself no relief, your eyes no rest.

verses.textZh: 夜里每到交更的时分，你要起来呼喊； 在主面前你要倾心如水！ 你的孩童在各街头上因饥饿而昏倒， 你要为他们的性命向主举手祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜里每到交更的时分，你要起来呼喊； 在主面前你要倾心如水！ 你的孩童在各街头上因饥饿而昏倒， 你要为他们的性命向主举手祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间，每逢交更的时候要起来呼喊， 在主面前倾心如水。 你的孩童在各市口上受饿发昏； 你要为他们的性命向主举手祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Arise, cry out in the night, as the watches of the night begin; pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint from hunger at every street corner.
verses.textEnEsv: "Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the night watches! Pour out your heart like water before the presence of the Lord! Lift your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise, cry out in the night, At the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift your hands toward Him For the life of your young children, Who faint from hunger at the head of every street."
verses.textEnNlt: Rise during the night and cry out. Pour out your hearts like water to the Lord. Lift up your hands to him in prayer, pleading for your children, for in every street they are faint with hunger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, whimper in the night At the beginning of the night watches; Pour out your heart like water Before the presence of the Lord; Raise your hands to Him For the life of your little ones Who languish because of hunger At the head of every street.
verses.textEn: Arise, cry out in the night, as the watches of the night begin; pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint from hunger at every street corner.

verses.textZh: "耶和华啊，求你观看！求你鉴察！你曾这样对待过谁呢？ 难道妇人应该吃掉自己所生的，就是自己所抚养的婴孩吗？ 难道祭司和先知应该在主的圣所里被杀害吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华啊，求你观看！求你鉴察！你曾这样对待过谁呢？ 难道妇人应该吃掉自己所生的，就是自己所抚养的婴孩吗？ 难道祭司和先知应该在主的圣所里被杀害吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你观看！ 见你向谁这样行？ 妇人岂可吃自己所生育手里所摇弄的婴孩吗？ 祭司和先知岂可在主的圣所中被杀戮吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Look, Lord , and consider: Whom have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have cared for? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.textEnEsv: Look, O Lord , and see! With whom have you dealt thus? Should women eat the fruit of their womb, the children of their tender care? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.textEnNkjv: "See, O Lord, and consider! To whom have You done this? Should the women eat their offspring, The children they have cuddled? Should the priest and prophet be slain In the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord , think about this! Should you treat your own people this way? Should mothers eat their own children, those they once bounced on their knees? Should priests and prophets be killed within the Lord’s Temple?
verses.textEnNasb: "See, Lord, and look! With whom have You dealt this way? Should women really eat their children, The little ones who were born healthy? Should priest and prophet really be killed In the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.textEn: "Look, Lord , and consider: Whom have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have cared for? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

verses.textZh: 少年人和老年人都在街上倒卧在地死了； 我的年轻男女都倒毙于刀下； 在你忿怒的日子，你杀了他们，你屠杀了他们，毫不怜惜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 少年人和老年人都在街上倒卧在地死了； 我的年轻男女都倒毙于刀下； 在你忿怒的日子，你杀了他们，你屠杀了他们，毫不怜惜。
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人和老年人都在街上躺卧； 我的处女和壮丁都倒在刀下； 你发怒的日子杀死他们。 你杀了，并不顾惜。
verses.textEnNiv: "Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets; my young men and young women have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered them without pity.
verses.textEnEsv: In the dust of the streets lie the young and the old; my young women and my young men have fallen by the sword; you have killed them in the day of your anger, slaughtering without pity.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Young and old lie On the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men Have fallen by the sword; You have slain them in the day of Your anger, You have slaughtered and not pitied.
verses.textEnNlt: "See them lying in the streets— young and old, boys and girls, killed by the swords of the enemy. You have killed them in your anger, slaughtering them without mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: "On the ground in the streets Lie young and old; My virgins and my young men Have fallen by the sword. You have put them to death on the day of Your anger, You have slaughtered, without sparing.
verses.textEn: "Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets; my young men and young women have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered them without pity.

verses.textZh: 你从四围招聚惊吓我的，好象招聚人过节的日子一样。 在耶和华忿怒的日子，没有人可以逃脱，可以生存。 我所抚育、所养大的，我的仇敌都灭尽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你从四围招聚惊吓我的，好象招聚人过节的日子一样。 在耶和华忿怒的日子，没有人可以逃脱，可以生存。 我所抚育、所养大的，我的仇敌都灭尽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你招聚四围惊吓我的， 像在大会的日子招聚人一样。 耶和华发怒的日子， 无人逃脱，无人存留。 我所摇弄所养育的婴孩， 仇敌都杀净了。
verses.textEnNiv: "As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the Lord ’s anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared my enemy has destroyed."
verses.textEnEsv: You summoned as if to a festival day my terrors on every side, and on the day of the anger of the Lord no one escaped or survived; those whom I held and raised my enemy destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have invited as to a feast day The terrors that surround me. In the day of the Lord’s anger There was no refugee or survivor. Those whom I have borne and brought up My enemies have destroyed."
verses.textEnNlt: "You have invited terrors from all around, as though you were calling them to a day of feasting. In the day of the Lord ’s anger, no one has escaped or survived. The enemy has killed all the children whom I carried and raised."
verses.textEnNasb: "You called as on the day of an appointed feast My terrors on every side; And there was no one who survived or escaped On the day of the Lord’s anger. As for those whom I brought forth healthy and whom I raised, My enemy annihilated them."
verses.textEn: "As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the Lord ’s anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared my enemy has destroyed."

verses.textZh: 我是在耶和华忿怒的杖下受过苦的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是在耶和华忿怒的杖下受过苦的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是因耶和华忿怒的杖， 遭遇困苦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord ’s wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of his wrath;
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the one who has seen the afflictions that come from the rod of the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnNasb: I am the man who has seen misery Because of the rod of His wrath.
verses.textEn: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord ’s wrath.

verses.textZh: 他领我，使我行在黑暗中，不行在光明里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我，使我行在黑暗中，不行在光明里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他引导我，使我行在黑暗中， 不行在光明里。
verses.textEnNiv: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light;
verses.textEnEsv: he has driven and brought me into darkness without any light;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has led me and made me walk In darkness and not in light.
verses.textEnNlt: He has led me into darkness, shutting out all light.
verses.textEnNasb: He has driven me and made me walk In darkness and not in light.
verses.textEn: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light;

verses.textZh: 他真是终日不停地反手攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他真是终日不停地反手攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他真是终日再三反手攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: indeed, he has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: surely against me he turns his hand again and again the whole day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely He has turned His hand against me Time and time again throughout the day.
verses.textEnNlt: He has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, He has turned His hand against me Repeatedly all the day.
verses.textEn: indeed, he has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.

verses.textZh: 他使我的肌肤衰残，折断我的骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我的肌肤衰残，折断我的骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我的皮肉枯干； 他折断 我的骨头。
verses.textEnNiv: He has made my skin and my flesh grow old and has broken my bones.
verses.textEnEsv: He has made my flesh and my skin waste away; he has broken my bones;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has aged my flesh and my skin, And broken my bones.
verses.textEnNlt: He has made my skin and flesh grow old. He has broken my bones.
verses.textEnNasb: He has consumed my flesh and my skin, He has broken my bones.
verses.textEn: He has made my skin and my flesh grow old and has broken my bones.

verses.textZh: 他筑垒围困我，使毒害和艰难环绕我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他筑垒围困我，使毒害和艰难环绕我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他筑垒攻击我， 用苦楚 和艰难围困我。
verses.textEnNiv: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
verses.textEnEsv: he has besieged and enveloped me with bitterness and tribulation;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has besieged me And surrounded me with bitterness and woe.
verses.textEnNlt: He has besieged and surrounded me with anguish and distress.
verses.textEnNasb: He has besieged and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
verses.textEn: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

verses.textZh: 他使我住在黑暗之处，好象死了许久的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我住在黑暗之处，好象死了许久的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我住在幽暗之处， 像死了许久的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.
verses.textEnEsv: he has made me dwell in darkness like the dead of long ago.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has set me in dark places Like the dead of long ago.
verses.textEnNlt: He has buried me in a dark place, like those long dead.
verses.textEnNasb: He has made me live in dark places, Like those who have long been dead.
verses.textEn: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

verses.textZh: 他筑墙围住我，使我不能逃出去； 他又加重我的钢炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他筑墙围住我，使我不能逃出去； 他又加重我的钢炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用篱笆围住我，使我不能出去； 他使我的铜链沉重。
verses.textEnNiv: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; he has weighed me down with chains.
verses.textEnEsv: He has walled me about so that I cannot escape; he has made my chains heavy;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has hedged me in so that I cannot get out; He has made my chain heavy.
verses.textEnNlt: He has walled me in, and I cannot escape. He has bound me in heavy chains.
verses.textEnNasb: He has walled me in so that I cannot go out; He has made my chain heavy.
verses.textEn: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; he has weighed me down with chains.

verses.textZh: 甚至我哀求呼救的时候，他也掩耳不听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至我哀求呼救的时候，他也掩耳不听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我哀号求救； 他使我的祷告不得上达。
verses.textEnNiv: Even when I call out or cry for help, he shuts out my prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: though I call and cry for help, he shuts out my prayer;
verses.textEnNkjv: Even when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: And though I cry and shout, he has shut out my prayers.
verses.textEnNasb: Even when I cry out and call for help, He shuts out my prayer.
verses.textEn: Even when I call out or cry for help, he shuts out my prayer.

verses.textZh: 他用砍凿好的石头堵塞我的道路， 他使我的路径曲折。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用砍凿好的石头堵塞我的道路， 他使我的路径曲折。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用凿过的石头挡住我的道； 他使我的路弯曲。
verses.textEnNiv: He has barred my way with blocks of stone; he has made my paths crooked.
verses.textEnEsv: he has blocked my ways with blocks of stones; he has made my paths crooked.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has blocked my ways with hewn stone; He has made my paths crooked.
verses.textEnNlt: He has blocked my way with a high stone wall; he has made my road crooked.
verses.textEnNasb: He has blocked my ways with cut stone; He has twisted my paths.
verses.textEn: He has barred my way with blocks of stone; he has made my paths crooked.

verses.textZh: 他像熊埋伏着，又像狮子在藏匿的地方，等候攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他像熊埋伏着，又像狮子在藏匿的地方，等候攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他向我如熊埋伏， 如狮子在隐密处。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a bear lying in wait, like a lion in hiding,
verses.textEnEsv: He is a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in hiding;
verses.textEnNkjv: He hasbeen to me a bear lying in wait, Like a lion in ambush.
verses.textEnNlt: He has hidden like a bear or a lion, waiting to attack me.
verses.textEnNasb: He is to me like a bear lying in wait, Like a lion in secret places.
verses.textEn: Like a bear lying in wait, like a lion in hiding,

verses.textZh: 他把我拖离大路，把我撕碎，弃我于荒野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把我拖离大路，把我撕碎，弃我于荒野。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我转离正路， 将我撕碎，使我凄凉。
verses.textEnNiv: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.
verses.textEnEsv: he turned aside my steps and tore me to pieces; he has made me desolate;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has turned aside my ways and torn me in pieces; He has made me desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: He has dragged me off the path and torn me in pieces, leaving me helpless and devastated.
verses.textEnNasb: He has made my ways deviate, and torn me to pieces; He has made me desolate.
verses.textEn: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.

verses.textZh: 他拉开了他的弓，立我作箭靶子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拉开了他的弓，立我作箭靶子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他张弓将我当作箭靶子。
verses.textEnNiv: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.
verses.textEnEsv: he bent his bow and set me as a target for his arrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has bent His bow And set me up as a target for the arrow.
verses.textEnNlt: He has drawn his bow and made me the target for his arrows.
verses.textEnNasb: He bent His bow And took aim at me as a target for the arrow.
verses.textEn: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.

verses.textZh: 他把他箭囊中的箭，射进我的肺腑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把他箭囊中的箭，射进我的肺腑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。
verses.textEnNiv: He pierced my heart with arrows from his quiver.
verses.textEnEsv: He drove into my kidneys the arrows of his quiver;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has caused the arrows of His quiver To pierce my loins.
verses.textEnNlt: He shot his arrows deep into my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the arrows of His quiver Enter my inward parts.
verses.textEn: He pierced my heart with arrows from his quiver.

verses.textZh: 我成了众民讥笑的对象，他们终日以我为歌嘲讽我 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我成了众民讥笑的对象，他们终日以我为歌嘲讽我 。
verses.textZhCuv: 我成了众民的笑话； 他们终日以我为歌曲。
verses.textEnNiv: I became the laughingstock of all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: I have become the laughingstock of all my people, the object of their taunts all day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have become the ridicule of all my people— Their taunting song all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: My own people laugh at me. All day long they sing their mocking songs.
verses.textEnNasb: I have become a laughingstock to all my people, Their song of ridicule all the day.
verses.textEn: I became the laughingstock of all my people; they mock me in song all day long.

verses.textZh: 他使我饱尝苦菜，饱享苦堇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我饱尝苦菜，饱享苦堇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用苦楚充满我，使我饱用茵陈。
verses.textEnNiv: He has filled me with bitter herbs and given me gall to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: He has filled me with bitterness; he has sated me with wormwood.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has filled me with bitterness, He has made me drink wormwood.
verses.textEnNlt: He has filled me with bitterness and given me a bitter cup of sorrow to drink.
verses.textEnNasb: He has filled me with bitterness, He has made me drink plenty of wormwood.
verses.textEn: He has filled me with bitter herbs and given me gall to drink.

verses.textZh: 他用沙石使我的牙齿破碎，把我践踏在灰尘中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用沙石使我的牙齿破碎，把我践踏在灰尘中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又用沙石碜断我的牙， 用灰尘将我蒙蔽。
verses.textEnNiv: He has broken my teeth with gravel; he has trampled me in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: He has made my teeth grind on gravel, and made me cower in ashes;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has also broken my teeth with gravel, And covered me with ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: He has made me chew on gravel. He has rolled me in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: He has also made my teeth grind with gravel; He has made me cower in the dust.
verses.textEn: He has broken my teeth with gravel; he has trampled me in the dust.

verses.textZh: 你使我失去了平安，我已忘记了福乐是甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我失去了平安，我已忘记了福乐是甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我远离平安， 我忘记好处。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
verses.textEnEsv: my soul is bereft of peace; I have forgotten what happiness is;
verses.textEnNkjv: You have moved my soul far from peace; I have forgotten prosperity.
verses.textEnNlt: Peace has been stripped away, and I have forgotten what prosperity is.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul has been excluded from peace; I have forgotten happiness.
verses.textEn: I have been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.

verses.textZh: 所以我说："我的力量已消失了， 我从耶和华所得的盼望也没有了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我说："我的力量已消失了， 我从耶和华所得的盼望也没有了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说：我的力量衰败； 我在耶和华那里毫无指望！
verses.textEnNiv: So I say, "My splendor is gone and all that I had hoped from the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: so I say, "My endurance has perished; so has my hope from the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said, "My strength and my hope Have perished from the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: I cry out, "My splendor is gone! Everything I had hoped for from the Lord is lost!"
verses.textEnNasb: So I say, "My strength has failed, And so has my hope from the Lord."
verses.textEn: So I say, "My splendor is gone and all that I had hoped from the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 回忆起我的困苦飘流，就像是苦堇和毒草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 回忆起我的困苦飘流，就像是苦堇和毒草。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你记念我 如茵陈和苦胆的困苦窘迫。
verses.textEnNiv: I remember my affliction and my wandering, the bitterness and the gall.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember my affliction and my wanderings, the wormwood and the gall!
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember my affliction and roaming, The wormwood and the gall.
verses.textEnNlt: The thought of my suffering and homelessness is bitter beyond words.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember my misery and my homelessness, the wormwood and bitterness.
verses.textEn: I remember my affliction and my wandering, the bitterness and the gall.

verses.textZh: 每逢我的心想起往事，我的心就消沉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢我的心想起往事，我的心就消沉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心想念这些， 就在里面忧闷。
verses.textEnNiv: I well remember them, and my soul is downcast within me.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul continually remembers it and is bowed down within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul still remembers And sinks within me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will never forget this awful time, as I grieve over my loss.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul certainly remembers, And is bent over within me.
verses.textEn: I well remember them, and my soul is downcast within me.

verses.textZh: 但我的心一想起下面这件事，我就有指望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我的心一想起下面这件事，我就有指望。
verses.textZhCuv: 我想起这事， 心里就有指望。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet this I call to mind and therefore I have hope:
verses.textEnEsv: But this I call to mind, and therefore I have hope:
verses.textEnNkjv: This I recall to my mind, Therefore I have hope.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I still dare to hope when I remember this:
verses.textEnNasb: I recall this to my mind, Therefore I wait.
verses.textEn: Yet this I call to mind and therefore I have hope:

verses.textZh: 耶和华的慈爱永不断绝，他的怜悯永不止息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的慈爱永不断绝，他的怜悯永不止息。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不致消灭， 是出于耶和华诸般的慈爱； 是因他的怜悯不致断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the Lord ’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.
verses.textEnEsv: The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; his mercies never come to an end;
verses.textEnNkjv: Through the Lord’s mercies we are not consumed, Because His compassions fail not.
verses.textEnNlt: The faithful love of the Lord never ends! His mercies never cease.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord’s acts of mercy indeed do not end, For His compassions do not fail.
verses.textEn: Because of the Lord ’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

verses.textZh: 每天早晨都是新的；你的信实多么广大！
verses.textZhCnvs: 每天早晨都是新的；你的信实多么广大！
verses.textZhCuv: 每早晨，这都是新的； 你的诚实极其广大！
verses.textEnNiv: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Theyare new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNlt: Great is his faithfulness; his mercies begin afresh each morning.
verses.textEnNasb: They are new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
verses.textEn: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 我心里说："耶和华是我的业分，所以，我必仰望他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心里说："耶和华是我的业分，所以，我必仰望他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里说：耶和华是我的分， 因此，我要仰望他。
verses.textEnNiv: I say to myself, "The Lord is my portion; therefore I will wait for him."
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord is my portion," says my soul, "therefore I will hope in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lordis my portion," says my soul, "Therefore I hope in Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: I say to myself, "The Lord is my inheritance; therefore, I will hope in him!"
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord is my portion," says my soul, "Therefore I wait for Him."
verses.textEn: I say to myself, "The Lord is my portion; therefore I will wait for him."

verses.textZh: 耶和华善待等候他的和心里寻求他的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华善待等候他的和心里寻求他的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡等候耶和华，心里寻求他的， 耶和华必施恩给他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis good to those who wait for Him, To the soul who seeks Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is good to those who depend on him, to those who search for him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is good to those who await Him, To the person who seeks Him.
