verses.textEn: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;

verses.textZh: 安静等候耶和华的救恩，是多么的美好！
verses.textZhCnvs: 安静等候耶和华的救恩，是多么的美好！
verses.textZhCuv: 人仰望耶和华， 静默等候他的救恩， 这原是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: it is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: It is good that one should wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis good that one should hope and wait quietly For the salvation of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So it is good to wait quietly for salvation from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: It is good that he waits silently For the salvation of the Lord.
verses.textEn: it is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 人在幼年时就负轭，是多么的美好！
verses.textZhCnvs: 人在幼年时就负轭，是多么的美好！
verses.textZhCuv: 人在幼年负轭， 这原是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.
verses.textEnEsv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis good for a man to bear The yoke in his youth.
verses.textEnNlt: And it is good for people to submit at an early age to the yoke of his discipline:
verses.textEnNasb: It is good for a man to bear The yoke in his youth.
verses.textEn: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.

verses.textZh: 他要无言独坐，因为这是耶和华加在他身上的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要无言独坐，因为这是耶和华加在他身上的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他当独坐无言， 因为这是耶和华加在他身上的。
verses.textEnNiv: Let him sit alone in silence, for the Lord has laid it on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Let him sit alone in silence when it is laid on him;
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him sit alone and keep silent, Because God has laid it on him;
verses.textEnNlt: Let them sit alone in silence beneath the Lord ’s demands.
verses.textEnNasb: Let him sit alone and keep quiet, Since He has laid it on him.
verses.textEn: Let him sit alone in silence, for the Lord has laid it on him.

verses.textZh: 他要把自己的口埋于尘土中，或者还有盼望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要把自己的口埋于尘土中，或者还有盼望。
verses.textZhCuv: 他当口贴尘埃， 或者有指望。
verses.textEnNiv: Let him bury his face in the dust— there may yet be hope.
verses.textEnEsv: let him put his mouth in the dust— there may yet be hope;
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him put his mouth in the dust— There may yet be hope.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them lie face down in the dust, for there may be hope at last.
verses.textEnNasb: Let him put his mouth in the dust; Perhaps there is hope.
verses.textEn: Let him bury his face in the dust— there may yet be hope.

verses.textZh: 他要让人打他的脸颊，要饱受凌辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要让人打他的脸颊，要饱受凌辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他当由人打他的腮颊， 要满受凌辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: let him give his cheek to the one who strikes, and let him be filled with insults.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him give his cheek to the one who strikes him, And be full of reproach.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them turn the other cheek to those who strike them and accept the insults of their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Let him give his cheek to the one who is going to strike him; Let him be filled with shame.
verses.textEn: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.

verses.textZh: 主必不会永远丢弃人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主必不会永远丢弃人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主必不永远丢弃人。
verses.textEnNiv: For no one is cast off by the Lord forever.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will not cast off forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
verses.textEnNlt: For no one is abandoned by the Lord forever.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will not reject forever,
verses.textEn: For no one is cast off by the Lord forever.

verses.textZh: 他虽然使人忧愁，却必照着他丰盛的慈爱施怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然使人忧愁，却必照着他丰盛的慈爱施怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 主虽使人忧愁， 还要照他诸般的慈爱发怜悯。
verses.textEnNiv: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: for, though he cause grief, he will have compassion according to the abundance of his steadfast love;
verses.textEnNkjv: Though He causes grief, Yet He will show compassion According to the multitude of His mercies.
verses.textEnNlt: Though he brings grief, he also shows compassion because of the greatness of his unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: For if He causes grief, Then He will have compassion In proportion to His abundant mercy.
verses.textEn: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 因为他心里本不是要人受困苦，或是要世人愁苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他心里本不是要人受困苦，或是要世人愁苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他并不甘心使人受苦， 使人忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: For he does not willingly bring affliction or grief to anyone.
verses.textEnEsv: for he does not afflict from his heart or grieve the children of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He does not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men.
verses.textEnNlt: For he does not enjoy hurting people or causing them sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: For He does not afflict willingly Or grieve the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: For he does not willingly bring affliction or grief to anyone.

verses.textZh: 人把地上所有被囚的，都践踏在脚下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人把地上所有被囚的，都践踏在脚下，
verses.textZhCuv: 人将世上被囚的踹 在脚下，
verses.textEnNiv: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,
verses.textEnEsv: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: To crush under one’s feet All the prisoners of the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: If people crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
verses.textEnNasb: To crush under one’s feet All the prisoners of the land,
verses.textEn: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,

verses.textZh: 或在至高者面前，屈枉正直，
verses.textZhCnvs: 或在至高者面前，屈枉正直，
verses.textZhCuv: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，
verses.textEnNiv: to deny people their rights before the Most High,
verses.textEnEsv: to deny a man justice in the presence of the Most High,
verses.textEnNkjv: To turn aside the justice due a man Before the face of the Most High,
verses.textEnNlt: if they deprive others of their rights in defiance of the Most High,
verses.textEnNasb: To deprive a man of justice In the presence of the Most High,
verses.textEn: to deny people their rights before the Most High,

verses.textZh: 或在诉讼的事上颠倒是非，主不都看见吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 或在诉讼的事上颠倒是非，主不都看见吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 或在人的讼事上颠倒是非， 这都是主看不上的。
verses.textEnNiv: to deprive them of justice— would not the Lord see such things?
verses.textEnEsv: to subvert a man in his lawsuit, the Lord does not approve.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or subvert a man in his cause— The Lord does not approve.
verses.textEnNlt: if they twist justice in the courts— doesn’t the Lord see all these things?
verses.textEnNasb: To defraud someone in his lawsuit— Of these things the Lord does not approve.
verses.textEn: to deprive them of justice— would not the Lord see such things?

verses.textZh: 除非主命定，谁能说成，就成了呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 除非主命定，谁能说成，就成了呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 除非主命定， 谁能说成就成呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not decreed it?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has commanded it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is he who speaks and it comes to pass, When the Lord has not commanded it?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can command things to happen without the Lord’s permission?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is there who speaks and it comes to pass, Unless the Lord has commanded it?
verses.textEn: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not decreed it?

verses.textZh: 或祸或福，不都是出于至高者的口吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 或祸或福，不都是出于至高者的口吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 祸福不都出于至高者的口吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both calamities and good things come?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that good and bad come?
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit not from the mouth of the Most High That woe and well-being proceed?
verses.textEnNlt: Does not the Most High send both calamity and good?
verses.textEnNasb: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High That both adversity and good proceed?
verses.textEn: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both calamities and good things come?

verses.textZh: 人活在世上，因自己的罪受惩罚，为甚么发怨言呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人活在世上，因自己的罪受惩罚，为甚么发怨言呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 活人因自己的罪受罚， 为何发怨言呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why should the living complain when punished for their sins?
verses.textEnEsv: Why should a living man complain, a man, about the punishment of his sins?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should a living man complain, A man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.textEnNlt: Then why should we, mere humans, complain when we are punished for our sins?
verses.textEnNasb: Of what can any living mortal, or any man, Complain in view of his sins?
verses.textEn: Why should the living complain when punished for their sins?

verses.textZh: 我们要检讨和省察自己的行为，然后归向耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要检讨和省察自己的行为，然后归向耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们当深深考察自己的行为， 再归向耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Let us test and examine our ways, and return to the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us search out and examine our ways, And turn back to the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, let us test and examine our ways. Let us turn back to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s examine and search out our ways, And let’s return to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我们要向天上的神，诚心举手祷告：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要向天上的神，诚心举手祷告：
verses.textZhCuv: 我们当诚心向天上的神举手祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven, and say:
verses.textEnEsv: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us lift our hearts and hands To God in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us lift our hearts and hands to God in heaven and say,
verses.textEnNasb: We raise our heart and hands Toward God in heaven;
verses.textEn: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven, and say:

verses.textZh: "我们犯罪悖逆，你并不赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们犯罪悖逆，你并不赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们犯罪悖逆， 你并不赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: "We have sinned and rebelled and you have not forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: "We have transgressed and rebelled, and you have not forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have transgressed and rebelled; You have not pardoned.
verses.textEnNlt: "We have sinned and rebelled, and you have not forgiven us.
verses.textEnNasb: We have done wrong and rebelled; You have not pardoned.
verses.textEn: "We have sinned and rebelled and you have not forgiven.

verses.textZh: 你被怒气笼罩着，你追赶我们，杀戮我们，毫不顾惜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你被怒气笼罩着，你追赶我们，杀戮我们，毫不顾惜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你自被怒气遮蔽，追赶我们； 你施行杀戮，并不顾惜。
verses.textEnNiv: "You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have slain without pity.
verses.textEnEsv: "You have wrapped yourself with anger and pursued us, killing without pity;
verses.textEnNkjv: You have covered Yourself with anger And pursued us; You have slain and not pitied.
verses.textEnNlt: "You have engulfed us with your anger, chased us down, and slaughtered us without mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: You have covered Yourself with anger And pursued us; You have slain and have not spared.
verses.textEn: "You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have slain without pity.

verses.textZh: 你用密云把自己遮蔽起来，以致我们的祷告不能达到你那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你用密云把自己遮蔽起来，以致我们的祷告不能达到你那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你以黑云遮蔽自己， 以致祷告不得透入。
verses.textEnNiv: You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.
verses.textEnEsv: you have wrapped yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can pass through.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have covered Yourself with a cloud, That prayer should not pass through.
verses.textEnNlt: You have hidden yourself in a cloud so our prayers cannot reach you.
verses.textEnNasb: You have veiled Yourself with a cloud So that no prayer can pass through.
verses.textEn: You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.

verses.textZh: 你使我们在万族中，成了渣滓和废物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们在万族中，成了渣滓和废物。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我们在万民中成为污秽和渣滓。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made us scum and garbage among the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made us an offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: You have discarded us as refuse and garbage among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: You have made us mere refuse and rubbish In the midst of the peoples.
verses.textEn: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.

verses.textZh: 我们所有的仇敌，都张开口攻击我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所有的仇敌，都张开口攻击我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的仇敌都向我们大大张口。
verses.textEnNiv: "All our enemies have opened their mouths wide against us.
verses.textEnEsv: "All our enemies open their mouths against us;
verses.textEnNkjv: All our enemies Have opened their mouths against us.
verses.textEnNlt: "All our enemies have spoken out against us.
verses.textEnNasb: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.textEn: "All our enemies have opened their mouths wide against us.

verses.textZh: 我们遭遇的，只是恐惧、陷阱、毁坏和灭亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们遭遇的，只是恐惧、陷阱、毁坏和灭亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 恐惧和陷坑，残害和毁灭， 都临近我们。
verses.textEnNiv: We have suffered terror and pitfalls, ruin and destruction."
verses.textEnEsv: panic and pitfall have come upon us, devastation and destruction;
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear and a snare have come upon us, Desolation and destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: We are filled with fear, for we are trapped, devastated, and ruined."
verses.textEnNasb: Panic and pitfall have come upon us, Devastation and destruction;
verses.textEn: We have suffered terror and pitfalls, ruin and destruction."

verses.textZh: 我的眼泪像江河流下，都因我的人民的灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼泪像江河流下，都因我的人民的灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我众民遭的毁灭， 我就眼泪下流如河。
verses.textEnNiv: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: my eyes flow with rivers of tears because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes overflow with rivers of water For the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textEnNlt: Tears stream from my eyes because of the destruction of my people!
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes run down with streams of water Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textEn: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.

verses.textZh: 我的眼泪涌流不停，总不止息，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼泪涌流不停，总不止息，
verses.textZhCuv: 我的眼多多流泪， 总不止息，
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes will flow unceasingly, without relief,
verses.textEnEsv: "My eyes will flow without ceasing, without respite,
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes flow and do not cease, Without interruption,
verses.textEnNlt: My tears flow endlessly; they will not stop
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes flow unceasingly, Without stopping,
verses.textEn: My eyes will flow unceasingly, without relief,

verses.textZh: 直到耶和华垂顾，从天上关注。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到耶和华垂顾，从天上关注。
verses.textZhCuv: 直等耶和华垂顾， 从天观看。
verses.textEnNiv: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees.
verses.textEnEsv: until the Lord from heaven looks down and sees;
verses.textEnNkjv: Till the Lord from heaven Looks down and sees.
verses.textEnNlt: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees.
verses.textEnNasb: Until the Lord looks down And sees from heaven.
verses.textEn: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees.

verses.textZh: 因眼见我城中众民的遭遇，我的心很痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因眼见我城中众民的遭遇，我的心很痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我本城的众民， 我的眼，使我的心伤痛。
verses.textEnNiv: What I see brings grief to my soul because of all the women of my city.
verses.textEnEsv: my eyes cause me grief at the fate of all the daughters of my city.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes bring suffering to my soul Because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is breaking over the fate of all the women of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes bring pain to my soul Because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.textEn: What I see brings grief to my soul because of all the women of my city.

verses.textZh: 那些无故与我为敌的人追捕我，像追捕雀鸟一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些无故与我为敌的人追捕我，像追捕雀鸟一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 无故与我为仇的追逼我， 像追雀鸟一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.
verses.textEnEsv: "I have been hunted like a bird by those who were my enemies without cause;
verses.textEnNkjv: My enemies without cause Hunted me down like a bird.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies, whom I have never harmed, hunted me down like a bird.
verses.textEnNasb: My enemies without reason Hunted me down like a bird;
verses.textEn: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.

verses.textZh: 他们把我投在坑中要结束我的性命，又把石头拋在我身上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把我投在坑中要结束我的性命，又把石头拋在我身上；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们使我的命在牢狱中断绝， 并将一块石头抛在我身上。
verses.textEnNiv: They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me;
verses.textEnEsv: they flung me alive into the pit and cast stones on me;
verses.textEnNkjv: They silenced my life in the pit And threw stones at me.
verses.textEnNlt: They threw me into a pit and dropped stones on me.
verses.textEnNasb: They have silenced me in the pit And have thrown stones on me.
verses.textEn: They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me;

verses.textZh: 水淹过我的头，我说："我要死了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 水淹过我的头，我说："我要死了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众水流过我头， 我说：我命断绝了！
verses.textEnNiv: the waters closed over my head, and I thought I was about to perish.
verses.textEnEsv: water closed over my head; I said, ‘I am lost.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters flowed over my head; I said, "I am cut off!"
verses.textEnNlt: The water rose over my head, and I cried out, "This is the end!"
verses.textEnNasb: Waters flowed over my head; I said, "I am cut off!"
verses.textEn: the waters closed over my head, and I thought I was about to perish.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，我从坑的最深处呼求你的名，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，我从坑的最深处呼求你的名，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊， 我从深牢中求告你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: I called on your name, Lord , from the depths of the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: "I called on your name, O Lord , from the depths of the pit;
verses.textEnNkjv: I called on Your name, O Lord, From the lowest pit.
verses.textEnNlt: But I called on your name, Lord , from deep within the pit.
verses.textEnNasb: I called on Your name, Lord, Out of the lowest pit.
verses.textEn: I called on your name, Lord , from the depths of the pit.

verses.textZh: 你曾经垂听我的声音，现在求你不要掩耳不听我求救的呼声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾经垂听我的声音，现在求你不要掩耳不听我求救的呼声。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾听见我的声音； 我求你解救， 你不要掩耳不听。
verses.textEnNiv: You heard my plea: "Do not close your ears to my cry for relief."
verses.textEnEsv: you heard my plea, ‘Do not close your ear to my cry for help!’
verses.textEnNkjv: You have heard my voice: "Do not hide Your ear From my sighing, from my cry for help."
verses.textEnNlt: You heard me when I cried, "Listen to my pleading! Hear my cry for help!"
verses.textEnNasb: You have heard my voice, "Do not cover Your ear from my plea for relief, From my cry for help."
verses.textEn: You heard my plea: "Do not close your ears to my cry for relief."

verses.textZh: 我每逢呼求你的时候，你就靠近我，说："不要惧怕！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我每逢呼求你的时候，你就靠近我，说："不要惧怕！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我求告你的日子，你临近我， 说：不要惧怕！
verses.textEnNiv: You came near when I called you, and you said, "Do not fear."
verses.textEnEsv: You came near when I called on you; you said, ‘Do not fear!’
verses.textEnNkjv: You drew near on the day I called on You, And said, "Do not fear!"
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you came when I called; you told me, "Do not fear."
verses.textEnNasb: You came near on the day I called to You; You said, "Do not fear!"
verses.textEn: You came near when I called you, and you said, "Do not fear."

verses.textZh: 主啊！你为我的案件申辩，赎回了我的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你为我的案件申辩，赎回了我的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤； 你救赎了我的命。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord, took up my case; you redeemed my life.
verses.textEnEsv: "You have taken up my cause, O Lord; you have redeemed my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, You have pleaded the case for my soul; You have redeemed my life.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord, you have come to my defense; you have redeemed my life.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You have pleaded my soul’s cause; You have redeemed my life.
verses.textEn: You, Lord, took up my case; you redeemed my life.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，你看见了我的冤屈，求你为我主持公道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，你看见了我的冤屈，求你为我主持公道。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你见了我受的委屈； 求你为我伸冤。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you have seen the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause!
verses.textEnEsv: You have seen the wrong done to me, O Lord ; judge my cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, You have seen how I am wronged; Judge my case.
verses.textEnNlt: You have seen the wrong they have done to me, Lord . Be my judge, and prove me right.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You have seen my oppression; Judge my case.
verses.textEn: Lord , you have seen the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause!

verses.textZh: 你已看见了他们种种的仇恨，以及所有害我的阴谋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你已看见了他们种种的仇恨，以及所有害我的阴谋。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们仇恨我，谋害我， 你都看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: You have seen the depth of their vengeance, all their plots against me.
verses.textEnEsv: You have seen all their vengeance, all their plots against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have seen all their vengeance, All their schemes against me.
verses.textEnNlt: You have seen the vengeful plots my enemies have laid against me.
verses.textEnNasb: You have seen all their vengeance, All their schemes against me.
verses.textEn: You have seen the depth of their vengeance, all their plots against me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你已听见了他们的辱骂，以及所有害我的计谋；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你已听见了他们的辱骂，以及所有害我的计谋；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你听见他们辱骂我的话， 知道他们向我所设的计，
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
verses.textEnEsv: "You have heard their taunts, O Lord , all their plots against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have heard their reproach, O Lord, All their schemes against me,
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you have heard the vile names they call me. You know all about the plans they have made.
verses.textEnNasb: You have heard their reproach, Lord, All their schemes against me.
verses.textEn: Lord , you have heard their insults, all their plots against me—

verses.textZh: 你也听见了那些起来攻击我的人嘴里的话，以及他们终日要攻击我的企图。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也听见了那些起来攻击我的人嘴里的话，以及他们终日要攻击我的企图。
verses.textZhCuv: 并那些起来攻击我的人口中所说的话， 以及终日向我所设的计谋。
verses.textEnNiv: what my enemies whisper and mutter against me all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: The lips and thoughts of my assailants are against me all the day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lips of my enemies And their whispering against me all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies whisper and mutter as they plot against me all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: The lips of my assailants and their talk Are against me all day long.
verses.textEn: what my enemies whisper and mutter against me all day long.

verses.textZh: 你看，他们或坐下或起来，我都成了他们歌唱嘲笑的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，他们或坐下或起来，我都成了他们歌唱嘲笑的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你观看， 他们坐下，起来，都以我为歌曲。
verses.textEnNiv: Look at them! Sitting or standing, they mock me in their songs.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold their sitting and their rising; I am the object of their taunts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look at their sitting down and their rising up; I am their taunting song.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at them! Whether they sit or stand, I am the object of their mocking songs.
verses.textEnNasb: Look at their sitting and their rising; I am their mocking song.
verses.textEn: Look at them! Sitting or standing, they mock me in their songs.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你按着他们手所作的，报应他们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你按着他们手所作的，报应他们！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你要按着他们手所做的 向他们施行报应。
verses.textEnNiv: Pay them back what they deserve, Lord , for what their hands have done.
verses.textEnEsv: "You will repay them, O Lord , according to the work of their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Repay them, O Lord, According to the work of their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Pay them back, Lord , for all the evil they have done.
verses.textEnNasb: You will repay them, Lord, In accordance with the work of their hands.
verses.textEn: Pay them back what they deserve, Lord , for what their hands have done.

verses.textZh: 求你使他们的心顽梗，愿你的咒诅临到他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使他们的心顽梗，愿你的咒诅临到他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要使他们心里刚硬， 使你的咒诅临到他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Put a veil over their hearts, and may your curse be on them!
verses.textEnEsv: You will give them dullness of heart; your curse will be on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give them a veiled heart; Your curse be upon them!
verses.textEnNlt: Give them hard and stubborn hearts, and then let your curse fall on them!
verses.textEnNasb: You will give them shamelessness of heart, Your curse will be on them.
verses.textEn: Put a veil over their hearts, and may your curse be on them!

verses.textZh: 求你在烈怒中追赶他们，从耶和华管治的天下除灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在烈怒中追赶他们，从耶和华管治的天下除灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要发怒追赶他们， 从耶和华的天下除灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You will pursue them in anger and destroy them from under your heavens, O Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: In Your anger, Pursue and destroy them From under the heavens of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Chase them down in your anger, destroying them beneath the Lord ’s heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: You will pursue them in anger and eliminate them From under the heavens of the Lord!
verses.textEn: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 黄金怎么竟然失去光泽，纯金怎么竟然变色？ 圣殿的石头都被拋弃在各街头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黄金怎么竟然失去光泽，纯金怎么竟然变色？ 圣殿的石头都被拋弃在各街头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 黄金何其失光！ 纯金何其变色！ 圣所的石头倒在各市口上。
verses.textEnNiv: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at every street corner.
verses.textEnEsv: How the gold has grown dim, how the pure gold is changed! The holy stones lie scattered at the head of every street.
verses.textEnNkjv: How the gold has become dim! How changed the fine gold! The stones of the sanctuary are scattered At the head of every street.
verses.textEnNlt: How the gold has lost its luster! Even the finest gold has become dull. The sacred gemstones lie scattered in the streets!
verses.textEnNasb: How dark the gold has become, How the pure gold has changed! The sacred stones are spilled out At the corner of every street.
verses.textEn: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at every street corner.

verses.textZh: 锡安尊贵的众民，本来和精金一样贵重； 现在怎么竟被看为瓦器，好象陶匠手中所作的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安尊贵的众民，本来和精金一样贵重； 现在怎么竟被看为瓦器，好象陶匠手中所作的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安宝贵的众子好比精金， 现在何竟算为窑匠手所做的瓦瓶？
verses.textEnNiv: How the precious children of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
verses.textEnEsv: The precious sons of Zion, worth their weight in fine gold, how they are regarded as earthen pots, the work of a potter’s hands!
verses.textEnNkjv: The precious sons of Zion, Valuable as fine gold, How they are regarded as clay pots, The work of the hands of the potter!
verses.textEnNlt: See how the precious children of Jerusalem, worth their weight in fine gold, are now treated like pots of clay made by a common potter.
verses.textEnNasb: The precious sons of Zion, Weighed against pure gold, How they are regarded as earthenware jars, The work of a potter’s hands!
verses.textEn: How the precious children of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!

verses.textZh: 野狗尚且用乳房哺养牠们的幼儿； 但我的众民变得多么残忍，像旷野的鸵鸟一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 野狗尚且用乳房哺养牠们的幼儿； 但我的众民变得多么残忍，像旷野的鸵鸟一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子， 我民的妇人倒成为残忍， 好像旷野的鸵鸟一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but my people have become heartless like ostriches in the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: Even jackals offer the breast; they nurse their young; but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even the jackals present their breasts To nurse their young; But the daughter of my people is cruel, Like ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the jackals feed their young, but not my people Israel. They ignore their children’s cries, like ostriches in the desert.
verses.textEnNasb: Even jackals offer the breast, They nurse their young; But the daughter of my people has proved herself cruel, Like ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but my people have become heartless like ostriches in the desert.

verses.textZh: 婴儿的舌头因干渴而紧贴上膛； 孩童求饼，却没有人分给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 婴儿的舌头因干渴而紧贴上膛； 孩童求饼，却没有人分给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃奶孩子的舌头因干渴贴住上膛； 孩童求饼，无人擘给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of thirst the infant’s tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.
verses.textEnEsv: The tongue of the nursing infant sticks to the roof of its mouth for thirst; the children beg for food, but no one gives to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The tongue of the infant clings To the roof of its mouth for thirst; The young children ask for bread, But no one breaks it for them.
verses.textEnNlt: The parched tongues of their little ones stick to the roofs of their mouths in thirst. The children cry for bread, but no one has any to give them.
verses.textEnNasb: The tongue of the infant clings To the roof of its mouth because of thirst; The children ask for bread, But no one breaks it for them.
verses.textEn: Because of thirst the infant’s tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.

verses.textZh: 那些从前吃美食的，现今都在街上孤单凄凉； 那些从前在豪奢生活中长大的，现今却在垃圾堆中打滚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些从前吃美食的，现今都在街上孤单凄凉； 那些从前在豪奢生活中长大的，现今却在垃圾堆中打滚。
verses.textZhCuv: 素来吃美好食物的， 现今在街上变为孤寒； 素来卧朱红褥子的， 现今躺卧粪堆。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those brought up in royal purple now lie on ash heaps.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who once feasted on delicacies perish in the streets; those who were brought up in purple embrace ash heaps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who ate delicacies Are desolate in the streets; Those who were brought up in scarlet Embrace ash heaps.
verses.textEnNlt: The people who once ate the richest foods now beg in the streets for anything they can get. Those who once wore the finest clothes now search the garbage dumps for food.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who used to eat delicacies Are made to tremble in the streets; Those who were raised in crimson clothing Embrace garbage heaps.
verses.textEn: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those brought up in royal purple now lie on ash heaps.

verses.textZh: 我众民 的罪孽比所多玛的罪恶更大； 所多玛在转眼之间倾覆了，尽管无人攻击它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我众民 的罪孽比所多玛的罪恶更大； 所多玛在转眼之间倾覆了，尽管无人攻击它。
verses.textZhCuv: 都因我众民的罪孽比所多玛的罪还大； 所多玛虽然无人加手于她， 还是转眼之间被倾覆。
verses.textEnNiv: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.
verses.textEnEsv: For the chastisement of the daughter of my people has been greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment, and no hands were wrung for her.
verses.textEnNkjv: The punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people Is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, Which was overthrown in a moment, With no hand to help her!
verses.textEnNlt: The guilt of my people is greater than that of Sodom, where utter disaster struck in a moment and no hand offered help.
verses.textEnNasb: For the wrongdoing of the daughter of my people Is greater than the sin of Sodom, Which was overthrown as in a moment, And no hands were turned toward her.
verses.textEn: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.

verses.textZh: 锡安的贵族素来比雪更明亮，比奶更洁白； 他们的身体比红宝石更红润，他们的样貌像蓝宝石一样美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的贵族素来比雪更明亮，比奶更洁白； 他们的身体比红宝石更红润，他们的样貌像蓝宝石一样美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的贵胄素来比雪纯净， 比奶更白； 他们的身体比红宝玉 更红， 像光润的蓝宝石一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like lapis lazuli.
verses.textEnEsv: Her princes were purer than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than coral, the beauty of their form was like sapphire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her Nazirites were brighter than snow And whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, Like sapphire in their appearance.
verses.textEnNlt: Our princes once glowed with health— brighter than snow, whiter than milk. Their faces were as ruddy as rubies, their appearance like fine jewels.
verses.textEnNasb: Her consecrated ones were purer than snow, They shined more than milk; They were more ruddy in body than pearls of coral, Their form was like lapis lazuli.
verses.textEn: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like lapis lazuli.

verses.textZh: 现在他们的面貌比煤炭还黑，在街上再没有人认得他们； 他们皮包骨头，枯瘦如柴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在他们的面貌比煤炭还黑，在街上再没有人认得他们； 他们皮包骨头，枯瘦如柴。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在他们的面貌比煤炭更黑， 以致在街上无人认识； 他们的皮肤紧贴骨头， 枯干如同槁木。
verses.textEnNiv: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
verses.textEnEsv: Now their face is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets; their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now their appearance is blacker than soot; They go unrecognized in the streets; Their skin clings to their bones, It has become as dry as wood.
verses.textEnNlt: But now their faces are blacker than soot. No one recognizes them in the streets. Their skin sticks to their bones; it is as dry and hard as wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Their appearance is darker than soot, They are not recognized in the streets; Their skin is shriveled on their bones, It is dry, it has become like wood.
verses.textEn: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.

verses.textZh: 那些死于刀下的比饿死的还好； 饿死的因缺乏田间的出产，就日渐消瘦而死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些死于刀下的比饿死的还好； 饿死的因缺乏田间的出产，就日渐消瘦而死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 饿死的不如被刀杀的， 因为这是缺了田间的土产， 就身体衰弱，渐渐消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.
verses.textEnEsv: Happier were the victims of the sword than the victims of hunger, who wasted away, pierced by lack of the fruits of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those slain by the sword are better off Than those who die of hunger; For these pine away, Stricken forlack of the fruits of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger. Starving, they waste away for lack of food from the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Better off are those killed by the sword Than those killed by hunger; For they waste away, stricken By the lack of the produce of the field.
verses.textEn: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.

verses.textZh: 慈心的妇人亲手烹煮自己所生的孩子； 在我众民 遭毁灭的时候，孩子竟成了母亲的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 慈心的妇人亲手烹煮自己所生的孩子； 在我众民 遭毁灭的时候，孩子竟成了母亲的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 慈心的妇人，当我众民被毁灭的时候， 亲手煮自己的儿女作为食物。
verses.textEnNiv: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: The hands of compassionate women have boiled their own children; they became their food during the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hands of the compassionate women Have cooked their own children; They became food for them In the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textEnNlt: Tenderhearted women have cooked their own children. They have eaten them to survive the siege.
verses.textEnNasb: The hands of compassionate women Boiled their own children; They became food for them Due to the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textEn: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华大发震怒，倾倒他的烈怒； 他在锡安放火，吞灭了锡安的根基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华大发震怒，倾倒他的烈怒； 他在锡安放火，吞灭了锡安的根基。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华发怒成就他所定的， 倒出他的烈怒； 在锡安使火着起， 烧毁锡安的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord gave full vent to his wrath; he poured out his hot anger, and he kindled a fire in Zion that consumed its foundations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has fulfilled His fury, He has poured out His fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion, And it has devoured its foundations.
verses.textEnNlt: But now the anger of the Lord is satisfied. His fierce anger has been poured out. He started a fire in Jerusalem that burned the city to its foundations.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has expended His wrath, He has poured out His fierce anger; And He has kindled a fire in Zion, And it has consumed its foundations.
verses.textEn: The Lord has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.

verses.textZh: 地上的君王，以及世上所有的居民都不相信， 会有任何敌人和仇敌攻进耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的君王，以及世上所有的居民都不相信， 会有任何敌人和仇敌攻进耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信 敌人和仇敌能进耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textEnNiv: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the peoples of the world, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any of the inhabitants of the world, that foe or enemy could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: The kings of the earth, And all inhabitants of the world, Would not have believed That the adversary and the enemy Could enter the gates of Jerusalem—
verses.textEnNlt: Not a king in all the earth— no one in all the world— would have believed that an enemy could march through the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: The kings of the earth did not believe, Nor did any of the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy Would enter the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the peoples of the world, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 因为锡安先知的罪恶，和祭司的罪孽， 就是他们在城中流了义人的血，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为锡安先知的罪恶，和祭司的罪孽， 就是他们在城中流了义人的血，
verses.textZhCuv: 这都因她先知的罪恶和祭司的罪孽； 他们在城中流了义人的血。
verses.textEnNiv: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: This was for the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed in the midst of her the blood of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the sins of her prophets And the iniquities of her priests, Who shed in her midst The blood of the just.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the sins of her priests, who defiled the city by shedding innocent blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the sins of her prophets And the wrongdoings of her priests, Who have shed in her midst The blood of the righteous,
verses.textEn: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 所以，他们像瞎子在街上流荡，他们被血玷污， 没有人可以触摸他们的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，他们像瞎子在街上流荡，他们被血玷污， 没有人可以触摸他们的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在街上如瞎子乱走， 又被血玷污， 以致人不能摸他们的衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Now they grope through the streets as if they were blind. They are so defiled with blood that no one dares to touch their garments.
verses.textEnEsv: They wandered, blind, through the streets; they were so defiled with blood that no one was able to touch their garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: They wandered blind in the streets; They have defiled themselves with blood, So that no one would touch their garments.
verses.textEnNlt: They wandered blindly through the streets, so defiled by blood that no one dared touch them.
verses.textEnNasb: They wandered, blind, in the streets; They were defiled with blood, Such that no one could touch their garments.
verses.textEn: Now they grope through the streets as if they were blind. They are so defiled with blood that no one dares to touch their garments.

verses.textZh: 有人向他们喊叫："走开！你们不洁的人；走开！走开！不要触摸我。" 他们到处逃亡飘流的时候，列国的人就说："他们再不能在这里寄居。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人向他们喊叫："走开！你们不洁的人；走开！走开！不要触摸我。" 他们到处逃亡飘流的时候，列国的人就说："他们再不能在这里寄居。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人向他们喊着说： 不洁净的，躲开，躲开！ 不要挨近我！ 他们逃走飘流的时候， 列国中有人说： 他们不可仍在这里寄居。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go away! You are unclean!" people cry to them. "Away! Away! Don’t touch us!" When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, "They can stay here no longer."
verses.textEnEsv: "Away! Unclean!" people cried at them. "Away! Away! Do not touch!" So they became fugitives and wanderers; people said among the nations, "They shall stay with us no longer."
verses.textEnNkjv: They cried out to them, "Go away, unclean! Go away, go away, Do not touch us!" When they fled and wandered, Those among the nations said, "They shall no longer dwell here."
verses.textEnNlt: "Get away!" the people shouted at them. "You’re defiled! Don’t touch us!" So they fled to distant lands and wandered among foreign nations, but none would let them stay.
verses.textEnNasb: "Keep away! Unclean!" they cried out of themselves. "Keep away, keep away, do not touch!" For they distanced themselves as well as wandered; People among the nations said, "They shall not continue to reside with us."
verses.textEn: "Go away! You are unclean!" people cry to them. "Away! Away! Don’t touch us!" When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, "They can stay here no longer."

verses.textZh: 耶和华亲临 分散他们，不再看顾他们； 人不再尊重祭司，也不厚待长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华亲临 分散他们，不再看顾他们； 人不再尊重祭司，也不厚待长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华发怒，将他们分散， 不再眷顾他们； 人不重看祭司，也不厚待长老。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord himself has scattered them; he will regard them no more; no honor was shown to the priests, no favor to the elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: The face of the Lord scattered them; He no longer regards them. Thepeople do not respect the priests Nor show favor to the elders.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord himself has scattered them, and he no longer helps them. People show no respect for the priests and no longer honor the leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: The presence of the Lord has scattered them, He will not continue to look at them; They did not honor the priests, They did not favor the elders.
verses.textEn: The Lord himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.

verses.textZh: 我们徒然等待帮助，等到双目失去视力； 我们在瞭望台上期望一个不能拯救我们的国家来临。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们徒然等待帮助，等到双目失去视力； 我们在瞭望台上期望一个不能拯救我们的国家来临。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们仰望人来帮助， 以致眼目失明，还是枉然； 我们所盼望的，竟盼望一个不能救人的国！
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.
verses.textEnEsv: Our eyes failed, ever watching vainly for help; in our watching we watched for a nation which could not save.
verses.textEnNkjv: Still our eyes failed us, Watching vainly for our help; In our watching we watched For a nation that could not save us.
verses.textEnNlt: We looked in vain for our allies to come and save us, but we were looking to nations that could not help us.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet our eyes failed, Looking for help was useless; At our observation point we have watched For a nation that could not save.
verses.textEn: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.

verses.textZh: 敌人追踪我们，使我们不敢在自己的街道上行走。 我们的结局近了，我们的日子满了； 我们的结局已经到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敌人追踪我们，使我们不敢在自己的街道上行走。 我们的结局近了，我们的日子满了； 我们的结局已经到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌追赶我们的脚步像打猎的， 以致我们不敢在自己的街上行走。 我们的结局临近； 我们的日子满足； 我们的结局来到了。
verses.textEnNiv: People stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.
verses.textEnEsv: They dogged our steps so that we could not walk in our streets; our end drew near; our days were numbered, for our end had come.
verses.textEnNkjv: They tracked our steps So that we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near; Our days were over, For our end had come.
verses.textEnNlt: We couldn’t go into the streets without danger to our lives. Our end was near; our days were numbered. We were doomed!
verses.textEnNasb: They hunted our steps So that we could not walk in our streets; Our end drew near, Our days were finished For our end had come.
verses.textEn: People stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.

verses.textZh: 追赶我们的比空中的鹰还快； 他们在山上追赶我们，在旷野埋伏攻击我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 追赶我们的比空中的鹰还快； 他们在山上追赶我们，在旷野埋伏攻击我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 追赶我们的比空中的鹰更快； 他们在山上追逼我们， 在旷野埋伏，等候我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles in the heavens; they chased us on the mountains; they lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the heavens. They pursued us on the mountains And lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Our enemies were swifter than eagles in flight. If we fled to the mountains, they found us. If we hid in the wilderness, they were waiting for us there.
verses.textEnNasb: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the sky; They chased us on the mountains, They waited in ambush for us in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.

verses.textZh: 耶和华所膏立的，我们鼻孔的气息，在他们的陷坑中被捉住； 我们论到他曾说："我们要在他的荫庇之下，在列国中存活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华所膏立的，我们鼻孔的气息，在他们的陷坑中被捉住； 我们论到他曾说："我们要在他的荫庇之下，在列国中存活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的受膏者好比我们鼻中的气， 在他们的坑中被捉住； 我们曾论到他说： 我们必在他荫下， 在列国中存活。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s anointed, our very life breath, was caught in their traps. We thought that under his shadow we would live among the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: The breath of our nostrils, the Lord ’s anointed, was captured in their pits, of whom we said, "Under his shadow we shall live among the nations."
verses.textEnNkjv: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, Was caught in their pits, Of whom we said, "Under his shadow We shall live among the nations."
verses.textEnNlt: Our king—the Lord ’s anointed, the very life of our nation— was caught in their snares. We had thought that his shadow would protect us against any nation on earth!
verses.textEnNasb: The breath of our nostrils, the Lord’s anointed, Was captured in their pits, Of whom we had said, " In his shadow We shall live among the nations."
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s anointed, our very life breath, was caught in their traps. We thought that under his shadow we would live among the nations.

verses.textZh: 以东人哪，乌斯地的居民哪，欢喜快乐吧！ 这杯也要传到你那里，你必喝醉以致赤身露体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以东人哪，乌斯地的居民哪，欢喜快乐吧！ 这杯也要传到你那里，你必喝醉以致赤身露体。
verses.textZhCuv: 住乌斯地的以东民哪，只管欢喜快乐； 苦杯也必传到你那里； 你必喝醉，以致露体。
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz; but to you also the cup shall pass; you shall become drunk and strip yourself bare.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, You who dwell in the land of Uz! The cup shall also pass over to you And you shall become drunk and make yourself naked.
verses.textEnNlt: Are you rejoicing in the land of Uz, O people of Edom? But you, too, must drink from the cup of the Lord ’s anger. You, too, will be stripped naked in your drunkenness.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice and be joyful, daughter of Edom, Who lives in the land of Uz; But the cup will pass to you as well, You will become drunk and expose yourself.
verses.textEn: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.

verses.textZh: 锡安的居民 哪！你的刑罚已经受够了，耶和华必不再使你流亡； 以东的居民哪！他必惩罚你的罪孽，揭露你的罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的居民 哪！你的刑罚已经受够了，耶和华必不再使你流亡； 以东的居民哪！他必惩罚你的罪孽，揭露你的罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罚受足了， 耶和华必不使你再被掳去。 以东的民哪，他必追讨你的罪孽， 显露你的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Your punishment will end, Daughter Zion; he will not prolong your exile. But he will punish your sin, Daughter Edom, and expose your wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: The punishment of your iniquity, O daughter of Zion, is accomplished; he will keep you in exile no longer; but your iniquity, O daughter of Edom, he will punish; he will uncover your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thepunishmentof your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; He will no longer send you into captivity. He will punish your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; He will uncover your sins!
verses.textEnNlt: O beautiful Jerusalem, your punishment will end; you will soon return from exile. But Edom, your punishment is just beginning; soon your many sins will be exposed.
verses.textEnNasb: The punishment of your wrongdoing has been completed, daughter of Zion; He will no longer exile you. But He will punish your wrongdoing, daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins!
verses.textEn: Your punishment will end, Daughter Zion; he will not prolong your exile. But he will punish your sin, Daughter Edom, and expose your wickedness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你记念我们所遭遇的！垂顾关注我们的耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你记念我们所遭遇的！垂顾关注我们的耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你记念我们所遭遇的事， 观看我们所受的凌辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember, Lord , what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember, O Lord , what has befallen us; look, and see our disgrace!
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember, O Lord, what has come upon us; Look, and behold our reproach!
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , remember what has happened to us. See how we have been disgraced!
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, Lord, what has come upon us; Look, and see our disgrace!
verses.textEn: Remember, Lord , what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.

verses.textZh: 我们的产业转归外人，我们的房屋归给异族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的产业转归外人，我们的房屋归给异族。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的产业归与外邦人； 我们的房屋归与外路人。
verses.textEnNiv: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.
verses.textEnEsv: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, And our houses to foreigners.
verses.textEnNlt: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, Our houses to foreigners.
verses.textEn: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.

verses.textZh: 我们成为孤儿，没有父亲，我们的母亲好象寡妇一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们成为孤儿，没有父亲，我们的母亲好象寡妇一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们是无父的孤儿； 我们的母亲好像寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: We have become fatherless, our mothers are widows.
verses.textEnEsv: We have become orphans, fatherless; our mothers are like widows.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have become orphans and waifs, Our mothers are like widows.
verses.textEnNlt: We are orphaned and fatherless. Our mothers are widowed.
verses.textEnNasb: We have become orphans, without a father; Our mothers are like widows.
verses.textEn: We have become fatherless, our mothers are widows.

verses.textZh: 我们所喝的水要用银子买，我们的柴也付代价而得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所喝的水要用银子买，我们的柴也付代价而得。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们出钱才得水喝； 我们的柴是人卖给我们的。
verses.textEnNiv: We must buy the water we drink; our wood can be had only at a price.
verses.textEnEsv: We must pay for the water we drink; the wood we get must be bought.
verses.textEnNkjv: We pay for the water we drink, And our wood comes at a price.
verses.textEnNlt: We have to pay for water to drink, and even firewood is expensive.
verses.textEnNasb: We have to pay for our drinking water, Our wood comes to us at a price.
verses.textEn: We must buy the water we drink; our wood can be had only at a price.

verses.textZh: 我们被人追赶，颈项带上重轭；我们疲乏，得不着歇息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们被人追赶，颈项带上重轭；我们疲乏，得不着歇息。
verses.textZhCuv: 追赶我们的，到了我们的颈项上； 我们疲乏不得歇息。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.
verses.textEnEsv: Our pursuers are at our necks; we are weary; we are given no rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: They pursue at our heels; We labor and have no rest.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are exhausted but are given no rest.
verses.textEnNasb: Our pursuers are at our necks; We are worn out, we are given no rest.
verses.textEn: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.

verses.textZh: 我们臣服埃及和亚述，为要得着粮食充饥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们臣服埃及和亚述，为要得着粮食充饥。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们投降埃及人和亚述人， 为要得粮吃饱。
verses.textEnNiv: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
verses.textEnEsv: We have given the hand to Egypt, and to Assyria, to get bread enough.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have given our hand to the Egyptians And the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.textEnNlt: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough food to survive.
verses.textEnNasb: We have submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
verses.textEn: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.

verses.textZh: 我们的先祖犯了罪，现在他们不在了；我们却要担负他们的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的先祖犯了罪，现在他们不在了；我们却要担负他们的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们列祖犯罪，而今不在了； 我们担当他们的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: Our ancestors sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.
verses.textEnEsv: Our fathers sinned, and are no more; and we bear their iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our fathers sinned andare no more, But we bear their iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors sinned, but they have died— and we are suffering the punishment they deserved!
verses.textEnNasb: Our fathers sinned, and are gone; It is we who have been burdened with the punishment for their wrongdoings.
verses.textEn: Our ancestors sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.

verses.textZh: 奴仆辖制我们；没有人救我们脱离他们的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奴仆辖制我们；没有人救我们脱离他们的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 奴仆辖制我们， 无人救我们脱离他们的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaves rule over us, and there is no one to free us from their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Slaves rule over us; there is none to deliver us from their hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Servants rule over us; Thereis none to deliver us from their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Slaves have now become our masters; there is no one left to rescue us.
verses.textEnNasb: Slaves rule over us; There is no one to rescue us from their hand.
verses.textEn: Slaves rule over us, and there is no one to free us from their hands.

verses.textZh: 因为旷野有刀剑的威胁，我们要冒生命的危险才得到粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为旷野有刀剑的威胁，我们要冒生命的危险才得到粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为旷野的刀剑， 我们冒着险才得粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: We get our bread attherisk of our lives, Because of the sword in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: We hunt for food at the risk of our lives, for violence rules the countryside.
verses.textEnNasb: We get our bread at the risk of our lives Because of the sword in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the desert.

verses.textZh: 我们因饥饿而发烧，我们的皮肤好象火炉一般的热。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们因饥饿而发烧，我们的皮肤好象火炉一般的热。
verses.textZhCuv: 因饥饿燥热， 我们的皮肤就黑如炉。
verses.textEnNiv: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.
verses.textEnEsv: Our skin is hot as an oven with the burning heat of famine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our skin is hot as an oven, Because of the fever of famine.
verses.textEnNlt: The famine has blackened our skin as though baked in an oven.
verses.textEnNasb: Our skin has become as hot as an oven, Because of the ravages of hunger.
verses.textEn: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.

verses.textZh: 妇女在锡安被污辱，处女在犹大的城镇被强暴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇女在锡安被污辱，处女在犹大的城镇被强暴。
verses.textZhCuv: 敌人在锡安玷污妇人， 在犹大的城邑玷污处女。
verses.textEnNiv: Women have been violated in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Women are raped in Zion, young women in the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: They ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Our enemies rape the women in Jerusalem and the young girls in all the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: They violated the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEn: Women have been violated in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.

verses.textZh: 众领袖被敌人吊起来；长老也不受人尊敬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众领袖被敌人吊起来；长老也不受人尊敬。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吊起首领的手， 也不尊敬老人的面。
verses.textEnNiv: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.
verses.textEnEsv: Princes are hung up by their hands; no respect is shown to the elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Princes were hung up by their hands, And elders were not respected.
verses.textEnNlt: Our princes are being hanged by their thumbs, and our elders are treated with contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: Leaders were hung by their hands; Elders were not respected.
verses.textEn: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.

verses.textZh: 青年人推磨吃苦；孩童因背木柴而跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 青年人推磨吃苦；孩童因背木柴而跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人扛磨石， 孩童背木柴，都绊跌了。
verses.textEnNiv: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
verses.textEnEsv: Young men are compelled to grind at the mill, and boys stagger under loads of wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Young men ground at the millstones; Boys staggered under loadsof wood.
verses.textEnNlt: Young men are led away to work at millstones, and boys stagger under heavy loads of wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Young men worked at the grinding mill, And youths staggered under loads of wood.
verses.textEn: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.

verses.textZh: 众长老不再坐在城门口；青年人不再唱歌作乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众长老不再坐在城门口；青年人不再唱歌作乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 老年人在城门口断绝； 少年人不再作乐。
verses.textEnNiv: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
verses.textEnEsv: The old men have left the city gate, the young men their music.
verses.textEnNkjv: The elders have ceased gatheringat the gate, And the young men from their music.
verses.textEnNlt: The elders no longer sit in the city gates; the young men no longer dance and sing.
verses.textEnNasb: Elders are absent from the gate, Young men from their music.
verses.textEn: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.

verses.textZh: 我们心里不再欢乐；我们的舞蹈变为哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们心里不再欢乐；我们的舞蹈变为哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们心中的快乐止息， 跳舞变为悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
verses.textEnEsv: The joy of our hearts has ceased; our dancing has been turned to mourning.
verses.textEnNkjv: The joy of our heart has ceased; Our dance has turned into mourning.
verses.textEnNlt: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
verses.textEnNasb: The joy of our hearts has ended; Our dancing has been turned into mourning.
verses.textEn: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.

verses.textZh: 冠冕从我们的头上掉下来。我们有祸了；因为我们犯了罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 冠冕从我们的头上掉下来。我们有祸了；因为我们犯了罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 冠冕从我们的头上落下； 我们犯罪了，我们有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.textEnEsv: The crown has fallen from our head; woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.textEnNkjv: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.textEnNlt: The garlands have fallen from our heads. Weep for us because we have sinned.
verses.textEnNasb: The crown has fallen from our head; Woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.textEn: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

verses.textZh: 为了这事，我们心里愁烦；为了这事，我们的眼睛昏花；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这事，我们心里愁烦；为了这事，我们的眼睛昏花；
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事我们心里发昏， 我们的眼睛昏花。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim
verses.textEnEsv: For this our heart has become sick, for these things our eyes have grown dim,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of this our heart is faint; Because of these things our eyes grow dim;
verses.textEnNlt: Our hearts are sick and weary, and our eyes grow dim with tears.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of this our heart is faint, Because of these things our eyes are dim;
verses.textEn: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim

verses.textZh: 因为锡安山荒凉，野狗就在山上到处出没。 祈求复兴
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为锡安山荒凉，野狗就在山上到处出没。 祈求复兴
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安山荒凉， 野狗 行在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.
verses.textEnEsv: for Mount Zion which lies desolate; jackals prowl over it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of Mount Zion which is desolate, With foxes walking about on it.
verses.textEnNlt: For Jerusalem is empty and desolate, a place haunted by jackals.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of Mount Zion which lies desolate, Jackals prowl in it.
verses.textEn: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华啊，你永远坐着为王；你的宝座代代长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华啊，你永远坐着为王；你的宝座代代长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你存到永远； 你的宝座存到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , reign forever; your throne endures to all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: You, O Lord, remain forever; Your throne from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNlt: But Lord , you remain the same forever! Your throne continues from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: You, Lord, rule forever; Your throne is from generation to generation.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么永远忘记我们？为甚么长久离弃我们？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么永远忘记我们？为甚么长久离弃我们？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何永远忘记我们？ 为何许久离弃我们？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you forget us forever, why do you forsake us for so many days?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You forget us forever, And forsake us for so long a time?
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you continue to forget us? Why have you abandoned us for so long?
verses.textEnNasb: Why will You forget us forever? Why do You abandon us for so long?
verses.textEn: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?

verses.textZh: 你向我们所发的怒气难收， 不然，求你使我们归向你，好使我们回转过来； 求你更新我们的日子，像古时一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你向我们所发的怒气难收， 不然，求你使我们归向你，好使我们回转过来； 求你更新我们的日子，像古时一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你使我们向你回转， 我们便得回转。 求你复新我们的日子，像古时一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Restore us to yourself, Lord , that we may return; renew our days as of old
verses.textEnEsv: Restore us to yourself, O Lord , that we may be restored! Renew our days as of old—
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn us back to You, O Lord, and we will be restored; Renew our days as of old,
verses.textEnNlt: Restore us, O Lord , and bring us back to you again! Give us back the joys we once had!
verses.textEnNasb: Restore us to You, Lord, so that we may be restored; Renew our days as of old,
verses.textEn: Restore us to yourself, Lord , that we may return; renew our days as of old

verses.textZh: 你竟全然弃绝我们， 向我们大发烈怒？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你竟全然弃绝我们， 向我们大发烈怒？
verses.textZhCuv: 你竟全然弃绝我们， 向我们大发烈怒？
verses.textEnNiv: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.
verses.textEnEsv: unless you have utterly rejected us, and you remain exceedingly angry with us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unless You have utterly rejected us, And are very angry with us!
verses.textEnNlt: Or have you utterly rejected us? Are you angry with us still?
verses.textEnNasb: Unless You have utterly rejected us And are exceedingly angry with us.
verses.textEn: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.
